jobs.title: Program Coordinator (Youth Services RAICES)
jobs.description:
The **RAICES Program Coordinator** will provide gender-specific services to youth who are at risk. The RAICES Program Coordinator is responsible for the coordination and management of school groups. Will provide supervision to the Youth Engagement Counselors by checking in and supporting group facilitation as needed.

**ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS / RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Primary Functions**

* Plan, coordinate, and evaluate gender-specific workshops, recreation and enrichment activities of the on-site and off-site RAICES program in accordance with contract regulations.
* Contact schools to coordinate groups for each cohort (Fall, Winter, Spring, and Summer Internship)
* Prepare and submit accurate reports as required by program, including monthly program reports to funding sources (DCYF) and the collection of evaluation and demographic data (surveys).
* Develop curriculum on gender specific topics such as healthy relationships, self-advocacy, hygiene, bullying, and others related to the DCYF contact.
* Supervise, evaluate and provide leadership development to Youth Engagement Counselors, Youth Interns, and volunteers involved in the RAICES program.
* Plan and implement project-based learning and experiential outings and activities to enhance youth learning and skill development.
* Plan outreach and resource events for the community, youth, schools, etc as part of the contract requirement.
* Ensure that all contact requirements are implemented, documented, and met.
* Support a program environment that is learner centered promotes a sense of physical and emotional safety.
* Support positive relationships between staff and youth, and between youth and their peers.
* Conduct case consultations and check-ins with the Youth Engagement counselors.
* Provide resources to youth, schools, families, community, and Youth Engagement Counselors.
* Communicate with school, community, public agencies and parents/guardians of youth.
* Supervise, evaluate and provide leadership development to youth interns and volunteers involved in the program.
* Ensure all youth completed the intake forms and communicate with youth families to complete.
* Utilize HUBB software to keep track of all youth’s profiles.
* Ensure Youth Engagement Counselors are completing incident reports on HUBB when youth disclose anything that would be reportable and is required to document.
* Provide individual follow-up services and information and referrals to youth as needed and to other MNC youth services and community services.
* Coordinates, schedules, and handles all logistical details of the weekly check ins and group coordination.
* Review CMS data and prepare monthly program reports.
* Develops and oversees outreach plan to recruit target population into case RAICES program.

* Monitors school advocacy efforts including school meetings such as parent conferences, IEP meetings, school disciplinary meetings, as necessary.
* Attending meetings with the Associate Director.
* Support the hiring process, selecting, interviewing, and filling out forms required to hire new employees in the department. Also, assist with the onboarding/offboarding of Youth Engagement Counselors.
* Supporting other MNC Programs as needed.

**Secondary Functions**

* Collaborate in the planning and production of community events including Dia de los Muertos, Holiday/Winter break, Black History month, Carnival SF, Spring break, family nights, program graduations and showcase, etc.
* Recruit in kind service providers to implement gender specific activities, cultural enrichment, health and wellness, youth leadership, and other enrichment activities within the program.
* Create partnerships with other organizations.
* Advocate for youth needs, providing referral information, when appropriate to internal and external services based on individual youth needs. Provide individual follow-up services to clients as needed.
* Collaborate with community to coordinate services.
* Represent MNC at appropriate community forums and funder meetings/trainings; maintain superior customer service with funders, staff, collaborating agencies, parents, and youth. Adequately inform, share information, and collaborate with anyone benefiting from the RAICES program.
* Maintain accurate program records and follow reporting procedures. Compile, analyze, verify, and submit data according to the funding schedule and guidelines.
* Participate in weekly staff meetings, 1:1 supervision, and as training courses are offered.
* Ensure team is completing all training, progress reports, and required documentation for program.
* Actively participate in the creation and implementation of a personal staff development plan striving for self-improvement.
* Must be available to participate in late afternoon, evening, and some weekend activities as needed (including Memorial Day Weekend, during school breaks, and MNC events).
* Ensuring that the curriculum, orders, and any required document is updated and completed.
* Collaborate with program staff to identify individual needs and create proactive strategies that foster social-emotional growth and success.
* Provide case consultations and support to staff, ensuring holistic and trauma-informed approaches.
* Maintain accurate program records and submit data in accordance with funding and reporting requirements.
* Attend required team meetings (weekly, monthly, and/or quarterly). Coordinate services with other MNC programs and community partners to ensure smooth referrals and continuity of care.
* Assist with planning and participating in MNC-sponsored community and cultural events.
* Supporting other MNC Programs as needed.

* Provide exceptional customer service.
* Provide fair and equitable support to all clients regardless of their situation.
* Always represent the organization in a professional manner.

jobs.title: Senior Program Coordinator
jobs.description:
IOA is on the forefront of revolutionary healthcare models, reshaping the way people can age in place. Our innovative models transform lives, enhance communities, and save healthcare systems millions of dollars. Rather than focusing on archaic outdated design, we strive to consistently question the “status-quo” and create new and more innovative ways to help aging adults and adults with disabilities maintain their quality of life.

With over 23 programs, we offer multiple ways to aid seniors maintain their health, well-being, independence and participation in the community, fulfilling our mission.

This 100% onsite role, serves as the key administrative support team member to the Enrichment Center and supporting other Companioa Programs, this role requires a highly organized and proactive individual to ensure maximum efficiency and streamline operations in a highly dynamic team. Primary duties include supporting client referral to enrollment process, client records compliance, transportation management, supply management, and program coordination.

**Prospects, Tours & Enrollments**

* Maintain a thorough knowledge of all dementia services to communicate Companioa programs effectively and accurately to referral sources, prospects, and other visitors to the Enrichment Center.
* Receive all incoming calls to main line at the Enrichment Center & provide response within 1 business day.
* Facilitate tours of the Enrichment Center for prospects and referral sources as needed and conduct timely follow up after tour to identify next steps.
* Proactively engage Director as enrollment barriers arise.
* Assist new client / family with Enrichment Center enrollment paperwork.
* Ensure all new clients have a successful transition to designated Companioa programs.
* Assist in completing & submitting transit applications and supplemental documentation for all impacted new enrollees.

**Client Records & Billing Management**

* Maintain daily attendance log with updates, notes, and client-specific needs.
* Enter client status updates (enrollment, disenrollment, hold, etc.) and notes for all communication with prospects and clients into electronic health record within 2 business days.
* Maintain accurate and up-to-date records for all funder & grant contracts using required systems.
* Completely and accurately follow client file checklists to ensure files are complete, current, and in compliance with licensing.
* Manage client roster for Enrichment Center and Care Coaching programs. This includes, providing enrollment and disenrollment information in the client health record and submitting accurate attendance reports to billing department.
* Maintain emergency rosters for all enrolled clients with a minimum of monthly updates.
* Collaborate with program liaisons at Veterans Administration, SF Department of Disability and Aging Services, and other grant/funders as needed.

**Transportation**

* Manage relationship and requests with outside transit providers, this includes assisting clients with Paratransit enrollment and coordinating requests for Group Van services, including participation in stakeholder meetings.
* Maintain transportation manifests for multiple providers.
* Document unmet and untimely service in internal logs & communicate with vendors in real time.

**Supply & Vendor Management**

* Coordinate meal service with outside vendor to ensure accurate count of meals based on forecasted Enrichment Center attendance.
* Maintain adequate stock of program materials and supply and replenish proactively.

**Other Duties**

* Participate in daily team meetings to inform Enrichment Center staff of the anticipated daily attendance and other details regarding prospects and other visitors.
* Assist Program Director in audit readiness and ongoing monitoring tasks to ensure compliance with state licensing regulations and other service contracts.
* Maintain knowledge of all safety and emergency protocols to effectively direct staff, clients, and visitors.
* Support Enrichment Center programs, including meals and activities, as needed.
* Actively participate in Companioa and IOA meetings.
* Other duties as assigned.

**EDUCATION:**

Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience.

**BACKGROUND AND EXPERIENCE:**

* Five years of program or administrative experience
* Interest and ability to support older adults, particularly persons with dementia
* Strong organizational skills with the ability to prioritize tasks and meet deadlines
* Ability to maintain effective relationships with a wide range of internal and external clients
* Team player
* Excellent written and oral communication skills
* Computer proficiency in Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook

**PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS:**

* Ability to lift 35 lbs
* Ability to reach, bend and walk

**COMPENSATION:**

**Range:** $ 34 - 35.50/hourly

*This amount is not necessarily reflective of actual compensation that may be earned, nor a promise of any specific pay for any specific employee, which is always dependent on actual experience, education and other factors.*

  

*This range does not include any additional equity, benefits, or other non-monetary compensation which may be included.*

jobs.company: Life Skills Training and Educational Programs - LifeSTEPS
jobs.title: Resident Services Coordinator/Program Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Join our team and make a difference in people’s lives! LifeSTEPS is committed to build thriving communities by empowering individuals and families through supportive housing and services.**

We are seeking a full-time, highly motivated **Resident Services Coordinator & After-School Program Coordinator** who will:

* Empower low-income individuals and families to flourish by providing education and resources.
* Ensure our residents, specifically older adults to have an opportunity to thrive in place through housing and services.
* Encourage individuals and families through stable housing and supportive evidence-based services to build resilient communities.
* Maximize the strengths of individuals by providing client assistance, case management, service coordination and conducting community outreach.

**Additional duties will include:**

* Empowering children from low-income and underserved families to flourish by providing After School education and resources.
* Ensure our young individuals a caring and safe place to go to After School to get assistance with homework and academic enrichment.
* Encourage children to thrive and become empowered so they can develop into resilient adults.

**Job Specifics:**

* **Formal Job Title:** Director of Social Services/Program Coordinator
* **Job classification:** Non-Exempt, Full-Time 34 hours per week (14 hours per week Director of Social Services/20 hours per week Program Coordinator)
* **Job location:** Oakland/Alameda, CA
* **Pay: $21.00 per hour (Program Coordinator), $28.35-$30.00 per hour (Director of Social Services)**

**More about us:**

The **STEP** in **LifeSTEPS** stands for **“Skills Training and Educational Programs”** and is the heart of our mission. We believe community development is built “One STEP at a time.” Our vision is that every person served by **LifeSTEPS** will be empowered with the skills, resources, and support to maintain stable housing and break the cycle of poverty. Our founders believe that building affordable housing is only the first step. It is also essential to provide meaningful programs that empower people to move forward in their lives.

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in social work, psychology or any related field.
* Two (2) years of experience in a similar environment providing social services to multi-families, senior and children.
* An equivalent combination of education and experience may substitute for the degree
* A background or experience working for a non-profit would be a big plus!
* Valid California Driving License and reliable, insured transportation required

Are you ready to make a difference, stand behind and support people so they achieve their goals and become empowered to move forward in their lives? **Apply today!!!**

*#SocialServices*

jobs.description:
**Company Description**

At Lucile Packard Children’s Hospital Stanford, we know world-renowned care begins with world-class caring. That's why we combine advanced technologies and breakthrough discoveries with family-centered care. It's why we provide our caregivers with continuing education and state-of-the-art facilities, like the newly remodeled Lucile Packard Children's Hospital Stanford. And it's why we need caring, committed people on our team - like you. Join us on our mission to heal humanity, one child and family at a time.  
  
**Job ID:** P146467-3080

This paragraph summarizes the general nature, level and purpose of the job.

The Program Coordinator provides operational coordination across the Community Partnerships portfolio, supporting implementation of the Community Investment Grants program, coordination of community partnership activities, community engagement initiatives, and Community Benefit reporting. This role coordinates program operations, documentation, communications, and workflows that enable the Community Partnerships team to carry out an expanding portfolio of initiatives supporting the organization's community health priorities.

**ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS**

The essential functions listed are typical examples of work performed by positions in this job classification. They are not designed to contain or be interpreted as a comprehensive inventory of all duties, tasks, and responsibilities. Employees may also perform other duties as assigned.

Employees must abide by all Joint Commission Requirements including but not limited to sensitivity to cultural diversity, patient care, patient rights and ethical treatment, safety and security of physical environments, emergency management, teamwork, respect for others, participation in ongoing education and training, communication and adherence to safety and quality programs, sustaining compliance with National Patient Safety Goals, and licensure and health screenings.

* Coordinate operational systems and logistics for Community Partnerships and departmental initiatives, including internal review processes, project tracking, meeting coordination, and preparation of committee and briefing materials for internal and external engagements.
* Coordinates logistical planning and execution for department meetings, grant partner events, community engagement events, site visits, and other stakeholder activities, including scheduling, registration, materials, vendor coordination, catering, technology, and day-of event support**.**

jobs.title: Senior Center Program Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Senior Center Program Coordinator**
=====================================

**Location:** San Francisco, California  
**Position Type:** Full-Time, On-Site  
**Schedule:** Monday–Friday, daytime hours  
**Local Travel:** Required within San Francisco

**Position Overview**
---------------------

We are seeking an energetic, community-focused **Senior Center Program Coordinator** to support programs that help older adults remain active, healthy, and connected. This position coordinates daily program activities, workshops, participant enrollment, community outreach, administrative functions, and services across multiple local sites.

The ideal candidate is bilingual, highly organized, comfortable working directly with seniors, and passionate about serving the community.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Coordinate daily senior center programs, activities, classes, and educational workshops.
* Assist with participant enrollment, referrals, and program documentation.
* Manage program schedules and coordinate staff coverage across service locations.
* Facilitate wellness workshops, educational classes, and outreach events.
* Build and maintain positive relationships with participants and community partners.
* Provide language assistance to participants with limited English proficiency.
* Coordinate partner meetings, take detailed notes, and track follow-up items.
* Maintain accurate participant records, operational documents, and program reports.
* Conduct site visits, program assessments, and community surveys.
* Collect donations and maintain accurate related financial records.
* Order, receive, organize, and track program supplies and inventory.
* Provide administrative assistance and serve as Staff on Duty when needed.
* Follow all organizational procedures, contractual requirements, and regulatory standards.
* Travel to additional program sites within San Francisco as required.

**Required Qualifications**
---------------------------

* Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education and professional experience.
* Bilingual fluency in one of the following:

  + English and Spanish
  + English and Chinese
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office and database management systems.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Excellent organization, time management, and attention to detail.
* Ability to follow detailed instructions and work independently.
* Ability to stand for extended periods and occasionally lift up to 50 pounds.
* Availability to travel between local program sites.

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* At least one year of experience working directly with older adults or senior populations.
* At least one year of community outreach or public engagement experience.
* Diabetes Educator, Health Educator, or related certification is a plus.

**Why Join Us?**
----------------

This is an opportunity to make a meaningful difference in the lives of older adults while supporting engaging wellness programs, educational initiatives, and valuable community services.

jobs.company: Episcopal Community Services of San Francisco
jobs.title: Meals Program Coordinator
jobs.description:
At Episcopal Community Services (ECS), employees work with participants who may be experiencing homelessness, behavioral health conditions, substance use challenges, and other difficult life circumstances. While this work is meaningful and mission-driven, it can at times be stressful, demanding, or unpredictable. Employees are expected to exercise sound judgment, remain aware of their surroundings, follow established safety, communication, and de-escalation procedures, participate in all required trainings, and promptly report incidents, threats, injuries, or unsafe conditions, in accordance with ECS policies and procedures.

This position is a fully onsite, client-facing role that requires in-person interaction and direct service delivery to participants at ECS program locations. Due to the essential nature of the duties and the need for consistent in-person engagement with clients, remote work or work-from-home arrangements are not available for this position.

**SUMMARY OF DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:**

The Healthy Aging Program Coordinator will oversee the DAS-funded meal programs, currently serving over 6000 meals each month at three ECS sites; Canon Kip Senior Center, 1064/66 Mission, and The Granada Hotel.

**PRIMARY DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Responsible for coordination of administrative and educational aspects of the DAS-funded meals program at three sites.
* Collect all daily meal recording data from all sites, assuring accurate and timely information.
* Provide accurate meal recording, assurance of proper lunch service protocols, and garner feedback from consumers.
* Facilitate the distribution and collection of the annual consumer survey at all sites.
* Work with Director of Healthy Aging and Director of CHEFs to identify and reduce areas of waste.
* Coordinate the collection of all monetary contributions at each site according to the program’s strict requirements.
* Support all sites with database entries of new intakes, annual assessment renewals, and quarterly recertifications.
* Assist third-party organizations to facilitate nutritional education sessions at three sites, selecting appropriate topics and collecting accurate attendance
* Act as a liaison between the ECS kitchen and individual site needs for optimal quality assurance.
* Ensure all required signage is posted at all sites.
* Attend staff and community meetings as needed.

**REQUIREMENTS:**

* Bachelor’s degree preferred
* At least 1 year experience in program coordination, project management or a related field is required
* Some experience working with people experiencing homelessness is preferred
* Collaborative work style, demonstrating initiative and flexibility
* Excellent written, verbal and interpersonal communication skills
* Computer and technology proficiency is required, with the ability to learn new applications quickly
* Commitment to ECS’s mission and to its organizational values
* Must be able to lift at least 10 pounds

**OTHER:**

Must secure annual TB test. Must be finger “imaged”. All offers are contingent on successful passing this background check. Will honor and abide by rules of confidentiality. Office space will be shared and will function as a group room when not in use as an office.

Join us and be part of something bigger – helping to simplify health care one person, one family and one community at a time.

**Position Summary**

The Operations Manager is a member of the Store Management team, and as such, fulfills the company purpose of helping people on their path to better health by driving store execution and performance while building consumer loyalty to CVS/pharmacy through a focus on excellent customer service. Under the supervision of the Store Manager, the Operations Manager will maintain an engaged, productive store team through strong leadership, demonstrating initiative and leading by example.

The Operations Manager is responsible for supporting the Store Manager in the total leadership and strategic operation of a CVS/pharmacy store including:

* Overall store management, supervision, and policy implementation
* Sales and inventory management
* Employee staffing, training, and development
* Financial management
* Customer service leadership

Unlike the Store Manager in Training position, the Operations Manager position is not part of the CVS/pharmacy Retail Management Development Program. Operations Managers are not eligible for direct promotion to Store Manager. Candidates with a short-term goal of becoming a CVS Store Manager should instead apply for Store Manager in Training openings.

Essential Functions:

1. Management

Lead others and work effectively with store crews

Supervise, assign and direct activities of the store’s crew

Effectively communicate information to store crew and supervisors in an open and timely manner

Support Store Manager with actions plans for operational and service improvement

2. Customer Service

Assist customers with their questions, problems and complaints

Promote CVS customer service culture (greet, offer help, and thank)

 **Required Qualifications**

Deductive reasoning ability, advanced analytical skills and computer skills.

Advanced communication skills, leadership, supervision, and influencing skill

Ability to work a full-time flexible schedule, including some early morning, overnight and weekend shifts, to work overtime as needed, and to respond to urgent issues at the store when they arise

  
**Preferred Qualifications**

Experience as a retail manager or supervisor

 **Education**

High school diploma or equivalent required

**Anticipated Weekly Hours**

40

**Time Type**

Full time

**Pay Range**

The typical pay range for this role is:

$23.45 - $37.45

This pay range represents the base hourly rate or base annual full-time salary for all positions in the job grade within which this position falls. The actual base salary offer will depend on a variety of factors including experience, education, geography and other relevant factors.

Our people fuel our future. Our teams reflect the customers, patients, members and communities we serve and we are committed to fostering a workplace where every colleague feels valued and that they belong.

**Great benefits for great people**

We take pride in offering a comprehensive and competitive mix of pay and benefits that reflects our commitment to our colleagues and their families.

  
This full‑time position is eligible for a comprehensive benefits package designed to support the physical, emotional, and financial well‑being of colleagues and their families. The benefits for this position include medical, dental, and vision coverage, paid time off, retirement savings options, wellness programs, and other resources, based on eligibility.

Additional details about available benefits are provided during the application process and on Benefits Moments.

jobs.title: Employee Benefit Senior Account Manager, Select
jobs.description:
**General Description:** Consultative account management partner for small employee benefits accounts. Activities include marketing, compliance education, strategic planning, plan implementation, and carrier issue resolution. Serve as day-to-day contact for larger, more complex small business clients.

\*\*Mainly a Remote Role, but must sit in the West Region and be commutable to a USI office in CA or AZ\*\*

**Responsibilities:**

* Provide proactive, consultative support to a book of assigned clients. Lead all meetings and interactions with clients.
* Evaluate Select product offerings and/or alternative funding programs for clients. As appropriate, guide clients through the transfer from fully insured to alternative funding benefit plan designs. Includes educating clients on underwriting and compliance requirements.
* Interpret clients’ current coverage plans, identify gaps, and recommend opportunities to expand lines of coverage. Provide insurance technical expertise to clients.
* Educate, advise, and aid clients on all compliance topics. Includes alternative funding requirements, ERISA, COBRA, FMLA, 5500s and Health Care Reform.
* Act as primary contact between clients and insurance carriers. Respond to requests for information, documents, and employee benefits insurance inquiries.
* Accountable for marketing and placement of client insurance renewals and new business. Includes:

• Evaluating plan options via quoting systems, general agents, and direct carrier engagement.

• Negotiate with carriers on renewal rate increases and prepare appropriate contractual changes.

• Provide insurance plan options and recommendations to clients.

• Communicate final placement details to insurers, clients, and participants.

* Develop employee communications for renewal changes, enrollment procedures, benefit changes and/or clarifications.
* Introduce clients to USI Benefit Resource Center for resolution support. Includes assistance with claims issues and benefit plan/policy questions.
* Provide oversight and assistance with employee issues such as enrollment and billing issues.
* Introduce clients to USI value-add services where appropriate.
* Maintain a high degree of accuracy in agency management and document management systems.
* Ensure client deliverable standards are met. Participate in peer review with team members.
* Keep current with industry information, technology, and trends.

**Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:**

* 4 years + experience in employee benefits industry or related marketplace.
* College degree preferred.
* Customer service experience preferred.
* Must hold Life & Disability insurance license.
* Comfortable with internet-based programs and Microsoft Office products.
* Ability to set priorities and manage deadlines.
* Ability to work in a fast-paced, team environment with minimal instruction.

* Strong verbal and written communications skills.
* Ability to define problems and generate potential solutions.

jobs.title: Strategy & Operations Lead, Capacity Ecosystems
jobs.description:
Meta's Infrastructure organization is seeking a Strategy & Operations Lead to join the Capacity Ecosystems team. This role sits at the intersection of strategic planning, analytical rigor, and large-scale program execution — supporting the decisions and operational systems that govern how Meta plans, allocates, and scales its infrastructure capacity across AI, data center, and compute ecosystems. You will operate with significant autonomy, define the frameworks and operating models the team relies on (including frameworks that support the org's rhythm of business), and drive high priority cross-functional initiatives from problem framing through to measurable outcomes. This is a role for someone who thrives in ambiguity, brings structure to complex multi-stakeholder environments, and can influence outcomes at the organizational level without direct authority.  
  
  

### **Strategy & Operations Lead, Capacity Ecosystems Responsibilities:**

* Define and support the analytical frameworks and decision models that inform capacity ecosystem strategy, including demand and supply dynamics, fleet utilization trade-offs, and infrastructure investment prioritization
* Lead the development and evolution of the team's strategic roadmap, synthesizing inputs from infrastructure, finance, supply chain, and engineering partners into a coherent, prioritized plan
* Drive the most complex and ambiguous cross-functional programs end-to-end — scoping initiatives, building execution plans, aligning stakeholders, managing dependencies, and holding teams accountable to delivery milestones
* Identify systemic gaps in capacity planning processes and operational workflows, design solutions, and lead implementation across partner organizations
* Own the design and continuous improvement of team operating cadences, including business reviews, planning cycles, and goal-tracking frameworks that provide leadership with clear visibility into ecosystem health and strategic progress
* Prepare and deliver executive-level briefings, strategic recommendations, and program status communications that accurately represent capacity ecosystem priorities, risks, and decisions
* Serve as a thought partner to the Director of Capacity Ecosystems and other leaders, pressure-testing strategies, surfacing risks early, and proposing course corrections based on data
* Build and scale internal knowledge-sharing and communication mechanisms that keep cross-functional partner organizations aligned on capacity ecosystem strategy and program progress
* Conduct deep-dive analyses on infrastructure capacity topics — including AI compute scaling, data center supply chain economics, and ecosystem bottlenecks — to surface insights that shape long-term strategy

  
  
  

### **Minimum Qualifications:**

* 8+ years of experience in strategy and operations, program management, management consulting, or equivalent roles within large-scale technology or infrastructure organizations
* Demonstrated experience leading complex, cross-functional programs with multiple workstreams and senior stakeholders, from initial scoping through delivery and retrospective
* Experience building quantitative models, scenario analyses, and data-driven decision frameworks applied to capacity planning, supply chain, infrastructure investment, or analogous domains
* Experience communicating strategic recommendations, program status, and analytical findings to executive audiences through written briefings, structured presentations, and business reviews
* Experience driving accountability and alignment across teams without direct reporting authority, including escalation management and cross-functional dependency resolution

  
  
  

### **Preferred Qualifications:**

* Demonstrated ability to integrate AI tools to optimize/redesign workflows and drive measurable impact (e.g., efficiency gains, quality improvements)
* Experience adhering to and implementing responsible, ethical AI practices (e.g., risk assessment, bias mitigation, quality and accuracy reviews)
* Demonstrated ongoing AI skill development (e.g., prompt/context engineering, agent orchestration) and staying current with emerging AI technologies
* Demonstrated ability to integrate AI tools into analytical or operational workflows to drive measurable efficiency gains or quality improvements
* Experience building operational processes, goal-tracking systems, or business review cadences from the ground up in ambiguous, rapidly evolving environments
* Background in infrastructure capacity planning, cloud operations, data center supply chain, or AI compute scaling at a hyperscale technology company
* Experience adhering to and implementing responsible, ethical AI practices (e.g., risk assessment, bias mitigation, quality and accuracy reviews)
* MBA or advanced degree in a quantitative or business discipline
* Demonstrated ongoing AI skill development (e.g., prompt/context engineering, agent orchestration) and staying current with emerging AI technologies
* Demonstrated ability to integrate AI tools to optimize/redesign workflows and drive measurable impact (e.g., efficiency gains, quality improvements)

  
  
  

### **About Meta:**

Meta builds technologies that help people connect, find communities, and grow businesses. When Facebook launched in 2004, it changed the way people connect. Apps like Messenger, Instagram and WhatsApp further empowered billions around the world. Now, Meta is moving beyond 2D screens toward immersive experiences like augmented and virtual reality to help build the next evolution in social technology. People who choose to build their careers by building with us at Meta help shape a future that will take us beyond what digital connection makes possible today—beyond the constraints of screens, the limits of distance, and even the rules of physics.

Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence.  
  
This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk.

  

**About this role**

The Brand Ops & Production team is seeking an experienced Senior Creative Operations Manager to lead, scale, and optimize delivery across our highest-velocity marketing engines. Partnering closely with Digital and Demand Gen Creative, Production, and Marketing stakeholders, you will build predictable workflows that ensure high-volume creative assets launch on time, at scale, and to our highest brand standard.

You are an organized, proactive creative operations manager who thrives in fast-paced environments. To support this mission, Muon seeks a People Operations Manager to join our rapidly growing People Operations team. The ideal candidate is a highly empathetic, high-integrity leader who will serve as the operational bedrock of our employee experience. Reporting to the VP of People Operations, you will lead a dedicated team delivering operational excellence across the employee experience balancing strategic scaling and compliance with a deeply human-centric approach.

This position is hybrid and requires working on-site in our San Jose, CA office three days per week. Could flex to accommodate remote for exceptional candidates who are located in the West Coast timezone and could travel to the Bay Area at least once a quarter.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Serve as a trusted, approachable point of contact for employees, handling complex personal or professional inquiries with total confidentiality.
* Manage sensitive employee relations and conflict resolution with fairness, discretion, and deep emotional intelligence.

**Qualifications**
------------------

* **Experience**: 8–12+ years of progressive experience in People Operations or Human Resources, with at least 4+ years of direct people management experience.
* **Scaling & Growth**: Proven track record of building, scaling, and managing People Operations functions through rapid hyper-growth phases.
* **Autonomy & Drive**: Proven ability to translate broad business goals into actionable project roadmaps and execute independently with minimal direction.
* **Total Rewards Strategy**: Strategic expertise in Total Rewards and benefits design, vendor negotiations, and overseeing end-to-end Open Enrollment strategy.

* **Legal Compliance**: Deep knowledge of multi-state federal, state, and local employment laws, compliance frameworks, and complex HR governance.
* **Aerospace Regulations**: Familiarity with ITAR/EAR regulatory compliance and security clearances and its implications on talent acquisition, onboarding, and export control workflows.

**Salary**

The salary range for this role is $193,000 - $214,000, plus a competitive equity grant and comprehensive benefits package. Final compensation will be determined based on skills, qualifications, experience, and geographic location as assessed during the interview process.

Founded in 2021, Muon Space is an end-to-end Space Systems Provider that designs, builds, and operates LEO satellite constellations delivering mission-critical data. Our revolutionary, integrated technology stack enables customers to optimize every dimension of their missions for faster time-to-orbit and superior constellation remote sensing performance. Our state-of-the-art facility in the heart of Silicon Valley is optimized for manufacturing spacecraft and rapid, flexible payload integration at scale. From climate monitoring to national security, Muon Space is dedicated to delivering Earth Intelligence for a safer and more resilient world.

**Taking Care of Our Team**
---------------------------

At Muon salary is only part of our total compensation package. In addition to salary, full-time employees receive equity compensation as well as benefits including medical, dental, and vision insurance, a 401k retirement plan, short & long term disability and life insurance. We also offer three weeks paid vacation for new employees, along with 12 paid holidays, unlimited sick time and paid parental leave.

 **What You'll Do**

* Program launch execution: Drive supply chain workstreams so programs launch on time. Identify critical-path bottlenecks across suppliers, internal teams, and sites, and stay on them until they are resolved
* Ambiguity to action: Take unstructured, cross-functional problems and distill them into scoped projects with owners, timelines, and success criteria. Follow up with action owners until issues are closed

* Cross-functional problem solving: Partner with Procurement, Planning, Engineering, Manufacturing, Logistics, and suppliers to diagnose root causes, align on trade-offs, and implement durable fixes
* Portfolio management: Run multiple initiatives in parallel without dropping business-critical work. Prioritize against launch dates, supply risk, and operational impact so business needs stay met
* Operating cadence: Stand up the forums, trackers, and escalation paths needed to keep launches and issue resolution moving. Surface trends early and drive continuous improvement
* Influence without authority: Build trust across functions and levels. Drive alignment and accountability in a matrixed environment where you may not own every resource

* 5+ years in supply chain operations, program management, or a similarly structured, cross-functional problem-solving role
* Consulting background strongly preferred — experience solving diverse problems across multiple projects, with demonstrated executive communication
* Proven ability to navigate ambiguous problems, structure them into functional workstreams, and drive action owners to resolution
* Track record of launching programs or delivering complex initiatives on time in a fast-paced operational environment
* Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, including briefing executives and working effectively with all levels of the organization
* Ability to manage a diverse set of initiatives in parallel while keeping business needs, priorities, and stakeholders aligned
* Strong analytical and structured problem-solving skills (issue trees, root cause analysis, 5-Why, data-driven recommendations)

jobs.title: Supply Chain Program Manager
jobs.description:
**Hyve Company Overview**
-------------------------

Hyve Solutions transforms complex engineering challenges into production reality for technology innovators building AI, cloud, and connected infrastructure. As a US-based manufacturing partner, the company rapidly delivers fast, agile execution through dep technical partnerships and co-innovation, and supply chain clarity. Hyve’s integrated ODM, CM, and SI capabilities eliminate vendor complexity while accelerating time-to-market with single-partner accountability from design through scale. The company co-innovates with deep engineering expertise, treating customer success as its own while building tomorrow's digital infrastructure.

  
  

This role is a critical strategic addition required to lead our high-priority supply chain transformation, technology integrations, and process optimization initiatives.

While a Systems and Process Analyst provides the technical diagnostics and workflow designs, the Program Manager will drive the cross-functional execution, manage vendor relations, govern the project portfolio, and ensure we realize the operational ROI of our system investments (such as ERP upgrades and global Material Requirements Planning (MRP) rollouts).

Primarily works with key stakeholders in supply chain team, IT, and direct operations teams.

**Key Responsibilities**

### **1. Process Mapping & Analysis**

* Document, map, and analyze "as-is" business processes across various departments to identify bottlenecks, redundancies, and areas for automation.
* Provide suggestions to senior management on process improvements.
* Conduct root-cause analyses on process failures and system issues.

### **2. Systems Evaluation & Integration**

* Evaluate existing MRP/ERP systems, software applications, and data flows to ensure they effectively support business processes.
* Collaborate with IT and software development teams to design, test, and implement system enhancements, APIs, or new platform integrations.

### **3. Requirements Gathering & Documentation**

* Facilitate workshops and interviews with stakeholders to gather detailed business and technical requirements.
* Translate business needs into clear technical specifications, user stories, use cases, and system flowcharts.
* Maintain comprehensive documentation of system configurations, process maps, and standard operating procedures (SOPs).
* Work as a Point of Contact for Supply Chain team to work together with quality team to perform ISO audit annually.

### **4. Project Management & Testing**

* Act as a project lead or key contributor on systems implementation and process improvement initiatives.
* Coordinate with Biz Ops team to perform User Acceptance Testing (UAT), and validate that new systems/processes meet defined business requirements.
* Create training materials and conduct training sessions to help teams transition smoothly to new systems and workflows (change management).

**Required Skills & Qualifications**
------------------------------------

### **Education & Experience**

* **Education:** Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Information Systems, Engineering, Supply Chain Management, or a related field.
* **Experience:** 5-10 years of experience in business systems analysis, process mapping, or operations analysis.

### **Technical Skills**

* **Process Mapping Tools:** Proficiency in tools like Visio.
* **ERP/Systems Knowledge:** Experience working with enterprise software (e.g., SAP, Oracle, Salesforce, Microsoft Dynamics, or specialized MRP/WMS systems).
* **Data Analysis:** Essential knowledge in SQL, Excel (advanced), and data visualization tools (Power BI) to analyze process performance metrics.

**Compensation:** The anticipated base salary range for this position is **$90,000-125,000 annually**.

Actual compensation will be determined based on experience, skills, qualifications, and business needs.

jobs.title: Assistant Project Manager
jobs.description:
The Assistant Construction Project Manager is a junior, field-based role that supports a Construction Project Manager across their portfolio of active ADU and residential builds. This person is the PM’s eyes and ears in the field - visiting job sites, documenting progress, and handling the coordination and follow-up that keeps projects moving. It is a developmental position built for someone young, ambitious, and technically curious who wants to learn the PM role from the ground up and grow into managing their own portfolio within roughly 12–18 months.

**Essential Duties & Responsibilities**

* **Serve as the PM’s eyes and ears in the field** — conduct site visits across the PM’s active projects to observe progress, quality, and site conditions, and report back clearly.
* **Document everything** — capture daily logs, progress photos, and written field notes in Buildertrend so every project has an accurate, current record.
* Track subcontractor attendance and progress against the schedule; flag no-shows, delays, and slipping milestones to the PM immediately.
* Help coordinate subcontractor trades, material deliveries, and inspection scheduling under the PM’s direction.
* Confirm client-selected materials and finishes have arrived on site and match the project scope.
* Prepare job sites for inspections — verify access, cleanliness, and that required work is complete and ready.
* Follow up on punch-list and correction items, and confirm completion back to the PM.
* Run materials, documents, and equipment between job sites, suppliers, and the office as needed.
* Communicate professionally with homeowners on routine field matters; escalate anything sensitive or contractual to the PM.
* Learn IMKAT’s construction process, sequencing, and standards — take on increasing responsibility as skills develop.

**Experience**

* 2 years in construction, the trades, or a related field role - internships, labor, or trade experience all count.
* Exposure to residential construction job sites preferred, but a strong learner with the right drive will be considered.

**Technical Aptitude**

* Comfortable using a smartphone and software for documentation, photos, and communication; quick to pick up new tools like Buildertrend.

Pay: $29.00 - $33.00 per hour

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* 401(k) matching
* Dental insurance
* Flexible schedule
* Health insurance
* Paid time off

Work Location: On the road

jobs.title: Richmond- ASP Program Leader
jobs.description:
**Careers by** **E****mpowering Futures, Building Communities**

Imagine going to work each day knowing that your efforts positively impact individuals and communities. As a global movement and the nation's leading nonprofit organization dedicated to strengthening communities through youth development, healthy living, and social responsibility, the YMCA of Greater San Francisco offers more than just a job—we offer a career with a future and the opportunity to make a lasting difference in your community. At the Y, you can uncover your passion and build a lifelong career addressing some of the nation's most pressing social issues.

**Our Organizational Culture**

At the YMCA of Greater San Francisco, we are committed to demonstrating values that aim to building strong communities where you can **Be**, **Belong** and **Become.** With **Truth & Courage**, we strive to understand and act on individual and societal truths. We ensure a safe and inclusive environment with **Authenticity & Accessibility**, allowing everyone to participate according to their needs. Our approach is **Dependable & Creative**, as we respond to community needs through strong partnerships. Above all, we embody **Dignity & Empathy**, treating everyone with respect and compassion, and recognizing the inherent dignity in all individuals.

**Qualifications**

* 18+ for elementary programs; 21+ for middle school programs.
* Associate’s degree or higher, or High School diploma/equivalent with one of the following:

o 48+ completed college units (verified by transcript),

o Passing score on the CA Basic Education Skills Test (CBEST), or

o Passing score on a District Instructional Aide Exam.

* Strong teamwork and communication skills.
* Knowledge of youth development principles.
* Available Monday–Friday during program hours
* TB Test clearance within last 2 years (required for programs on school district sites).

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in child development or related field OR equivalent professional and community experience.
* Experience working with elementary or middle school-aged youth.
* Bilingual skills in Spanish, Cantonese, Mandarin, or other languages.
* Knowledge of arts, dance, drama, sports, or other enrichment areas.

**Position Summary**

The After School Program Leader provides meaningful opportunities for youth in YMCA programs at local elementary and middle schools. They work under the supervision of Program Site Coordinators and Directors and are expected to demonstrate flexibility, initiative, and punctuality, with a commitment to the school-year schedule.

  

***After School Program Dates***

* *San Francisco Sites: August 10, 2026 – June 2, 2027*

**Job Responsibilities**  
**Curriculum Development & Program Delivery**

* Design and implement engaging, inclusive, and theme-based curricula that reflect the developmental stages and cultural backgrounds of youth.

* Facilitate academic enrichment, tutoring, and structured outdoor recreational activities.

* Partner with staff, caregivers, and participants to plan and enhance program offerings.

**Supervision & Safety**  
Supervise groups of up to 20 students, ensuring a safe, supportive, and inclusive environment in alignment with YMCA and child safety protocols.  
Actively monitor participants, respond promptly to incidents, and consistently apply safety guideline

**Record-Keeping & Compliance**

* Maintain accurate and up-to-date program records, including attendance, emergency information, and safety documentation

**Communication & Engagement**

* Communicate clearly and respectfully with participants, caregivers, staff, and volunteers to support a positive program experience.

**Training & Development**

* Complete required safety and program training before the first shift and attend all mandatory meetings and training sessions.

  

**Work Environment & Physical Demands**

The After School Program Leader works in a dynamic environment at local elementary or middle school sites, including indoor classrooms and outdoor schoolyards. The role involves frequent standing, walking, and active participation in physical activities such as recreational sports and games. The environment can be fast-paced and loud, and the role may require occasional lifting of up to 20 pounds.

  

**Disclaimers**

* Must successfully complete a background screening, including criminal and employment verification. Some positions may also require a credit check.

* All duties and responsibilities are essential job functions subject to reasonable accommodation. The YMCA of Greater San Francisco promotes an equal employment opportunity workplace, which includes reasonable accommodation for otherwise qualified disabled applicants and employees. Please contact your manager if you have any questions about this policy or these job duties.

* This job description may not be all-inclusive, and employees are expected to perform other duties as assigned by management. Job descriptions and duties may be modified by management as needed.

* Job offers are conditional and contingent upon background clearance. Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance and CA Fair Chance Act, we will consider qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records for employment.

  

**Salary Description**  
The After School Program Leader position offers a compensation range of $24.00 – $25.50 per hour. This rate is based on salary benchmarking for similar roles and is aligned with grant fund approvals and requirements for the position.

  

**The YMCA of Greater San Francisco is seeking Program Leaders at the following sites:**

* Richmond- Claire Lilienthal Elementary School
* Richmond- Jefferson Elementary School
* Richmond- Sutro Elementary School

jobs.title: Manager, IT Service Delivery
jobs.description:
Olema Oncology is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company committed to transforming the standard of care and improving outcomes for patients living with breast cancer and beyond. With our transformation into a fully integrated oncology company well underway, it's an exciting time to be part of Team Olema.

Our lead product candidate, palazestrant, is a novel, orally available complete estrogen receptor antagonist (CERAN) and selective estrogen receptor degrader (SERD) currently in two pivotal Phase 3 clinical trials. We expect top-line data from OPERA-01, our ongoing Phase 3 trial of palazestrant as a monotherapy in patients with second- or third-line ER+/HER2- metastatic breast cancer (MBC), in Q1 2027 which, if positive, could lead to our first potential approval and commercial launch in 2028. OPERA-02, our Phase 3 trial of palazestrant in combination with ribociblib in patients with frontline ER+/HER2- MBC, is enrolling patients. Together with its mechanism of action, pharmacokinetic properties, and the potential to demonstrate activity in both ESR1 wild-type and mutant tumors, palazestrant could transform the metastatic breast cancer treatment paradigm and provide access to a $15 billion global market opportunity.

Our follow-on product candidate, OP-3136, is a potent KAT6 inhibitor with the potential to generate further value and meaningfully impact the metastatic breast cancer treatment landscape – particularly in combination with palazestrant. We recently presented encouraging Phase 1 monotherapy data from this program across multiple solid tumor types, are advancing patient enrollment in the ongoing combination arms in MBC, and expect to initiate a Phase 1 study of OP-3136 in combination with Bayer's darolutamide in metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer by the end of this year.

Aspiring to transform the metastatic treatment paradigm is an ambitious endeavor that requires a resolute approach to developing better therapies and passionate colleagues dedicated to helping the patients we serve feel better, longer. Team Olema possesses a deep commitment to a shared purpose, the sustained pursuit of excellence, cultivating the courage required to advance our programs, the drive to succeed, and a collective capacity for adaptability through learning, growth, and evolution. We are a small group of nimble self-starters who bring consistency in our quest for the extraordinary every single day.

If you're ready to be part of a tenacious, courageous, agile, and growing team, join us in making a profound impact, together – for our patients, for your career, and for what's beyond.

jobs.title: Program Manager, Sanctions Compliance (OFAC)
jobs.description:
**About Us**

Founded in 1882, Matson (NYSE: MATX) is a leading provider of ocean transportation and logistics services. Matson provides a vital lifeline of ocean freight transportation services to the domestic, non-contiguous economies of Hawaii, Alaska, and Guam, and to other island economies in Micronesia. Matson also operates premium, expedited services from China to Long Beach, California, which includes cargo from other Asia origins, provides services to Okinawa, Japan, and the South Pacific, and operates an international export service from Alaska to Asia.

Matson Logistics extends the geographic reach of Matson's transportation network throughout North America and Asia. Its integrated logistics services include rail intermodal, highway brokerage, warehousing, freight consolidation, supply chain management, and freight forwarding to Alaska.

Matson is honored to be certified as a Great Place to Work. Learn more at www.matson.com.

**About the Role**

The **Program Manager, Sanctions Compliance (OFAC)** serves as Matson’s specialist professional and subject matter resource for enterprise sanctions compliance, restricted-party screening, and related international trade controls. The position independently manages large and complex compliance processes with limited oversight and is responsible for translating applicable sanctions requirements into practical policies, procedures, controls, investigations, training, and business guidance.

The role leads administration and continuous improvement of sanctions screening across relevant counterparties, transactions, shipments, and geographies. It partners across Legal, Operations, Technology, Finance, Procurement, and Commercial functions to strengthen screening coverage, data quality, system reliability, documentation, audit readiness, and timely escalation of potentially significant matters.

This is a hybrid position requiring onsite work at our Corporate Office in Walnut Creek, CA, three (3) days per week (Monday, Tuesday, and Thursday).

**What you’ll do:**

Sanctions screening, investigations, and advisory support; additional Treasury activities

* Own and administer enterprise sanctions and restricted-party screening processes for relevant counterparties, transactions, and shipments.
* Independently review, investigate, document, and disposition potential screening matches using available identifiers, ownership information, transaction details, shipment information, and other relevant evidence.
* Exercise sound judgment in determining false positives, documenting conclusions, identifying matters requiring further review, and escalating unusual, unresolved, or potentially significant concerns to designated Legal and business stakeholders.
* Prepare clear written findings, recommendations, decision records, and supporting evidence; coordinate required holds, restrictions, approvals, remediation, and follow-up actions through completion.
* Provide practical subject matter guidance to business teams regarding sanctions requirements, control expectations, and risk-mitigation measures.
* Participate in other day-to-day Treasury related tasks, including cash management, compliance (SOX, FBAR, KYC, Nacha, etc.), and bank account maintenance.

Program governance, policies, and risk management

* Develop, maintain, and implement sanctions compliance policies, procedures, standards, and controls aligned with applicable requirements and business operations.

* Monitor relevant sanctions developments, evaluate potential business impacts, and communicate recommended actions to appropriate stakeholders.
* Promote consistent execution of sanctions requirements across business units and operational processes without direct people-management responsibility.
* Maintain complete, organized, and audit-ready records demonstrating program execution, decision quality, and control effectiveness.

Technology, data, metrics, and continuous improvement

* Partner with Technology and business system owners to improve screening coverage, data quality, system integrations, workflow reliability, and the compliance evidence trail.
* Provide subject matter leadership for the selection, testing, implementation, and enhancement of sanctions screening platforms, case-management tools, and related compliance technology.
* Develop and maintain metrics, dashboards, and management reporting for screening volume, exceptions, escalations, completion, remediation, and control effectiveness.
* Identify and implement opportunities to automate controls, reduce manual effort, improve timeliness, and strengthen documentation and monitoring.
* Participate in the AI initiative by leveraging AI-driven solutions to enhance processes.

Audit, training, and stakeholder engagement

* Support internal audits, compliance reviews, control testing, assessments, and regulatory inquiries involving sanctions compliance.
* Develop and deliver sanctions compliance training and awareness materials for relevant employees and stakeholders.
* Track corrective actions and process improvements through completion and verify that identified deficiencies are remediated.
* Lead cross-functional workstreams and coordinate the contributions of other professionals; coach or provide technical guidance on sanctions processes as needed.

It started with a simple idea: what if surgery could be less invasive and recovery less painful? Nearly 30 years later, that question still fuels everything we do at **Intuitive**. As a global leader in **robotic-assisted surgery** and **minimally invasive care**, our technologies—like the **da Vinci surgical system** and **Ion**—have transformed how care is delivered for millions of patients worldwide.

We’re a team of engineers, clinicians, and innovators united by one purpose: to make surgery smarter, safer, and more human. Every day, our work helps care teams perform with greater precision and patients recover faster, improving outcomes around the world.

The problems we solve demand creativity, rigor, and collaboration. The work is challenging, but deeply meaningful—because every improvement we make has the potential to change a life.

If you’re ready to contribute to something bigger than yourself and help **transform the future of healthcare**, you’ll find your purpose here.

### **Job Description**

**rimary Function of Position**

* Responsible for supply chain readiness, launch, and scale of new robotic systems platforms.
* Manages supply chain deliverables for new product introductions (NPI) of the highest value with the most complex direct materials, including supplier selection & sourcing, leading creation & adoption of category launch roadmaps, leading cross functional projects to launch & scale new products, developing & negotiating contracts, analyzing spend, creating inventory management strategies, and managing supplier performance.
* Thought leader within Global Supply Chain: develops and refines key business processes; champions and mentors team members in use of Sourcing processes; monitors industry and professional best practices

**Essential Job Duties**

* New Product Program Leadership & Category Management
  + Provides cross-functional team leadership within assigned new product program(s) of highest complexity; leads cross functional program updates, executive reviews, and alignment forums.
  + Leads creation, management, and execution of program roadmaps to achieve cost, capacity, speed to market, and risk contract goals.
  + Provides cross-functional team leadership within assigned category(ies) of highest complexity; leads cross-functional category team meetings

* **Leads creation of long-term supplier strategies and roadmaps; able to navigate complex trade-offs in supplier strategies. Effectively influences broader organization through expert requirements gathering and leading adoption of developed strategies.**
* **Co-leads direct procurement supplier selection process with collaboration from Supplier Engineering. Expertly and independently deploys strategic sourcing practices to identify a core supply base able to offer lowest total cost of ownership and high-quality product while identifying value improvement opportunities.**

  

* **Supplier Performance Management**

* Proactively collaborates with supply base and procurement team to understand and communicate demand changes and minimize excess inventory or material shortages during program development. Able to expertly translate business shifts and design changes to suppliers and effectively understand root cause of demand changes internally.
* Collaborate with strategic sourcing teams on shared supplier performance escalations, lead supplier escalations for new suppliers to support NPI program deliverables.
* Effectively escalates for issue resolution with supplier executive leadership. Possesses executive presence and awareness and able to drive problem resolution onsite at suppliers.

  

* **Risk and Capacity Management**

* Develops high complexity mitigation plans and programs for assigned suppliers and critical sub-tier suppliers; implements plans when applicable
* Leads capacity assessments for assigned suppliers and critical sub-tier suppliers; operating on three-to-five-year horizon for capacity strategies for global category and able to marshal support for proactive mitigations
* May serve as project manager for key supplier capacity or risk mitigation initiatives
* Leverages problem solving skills and develops counter-measures to implement long-term solutions to identified problems

jobs.title: Dental Program Manager
jobs.description:
**Overall Summary:**

BACH Dental Program Managers are responsible for the successful management and operation of the site(s), and to assure the smooth operation of clinic based services and achievement of team-based productivity benchmarks. The Dental Program Manager monitors on-site dental clinic operations and is responsible for addressing and resolving day-to-day issues effecting clinic inefficiencies in patient flow by addressing system problems in a resourceful and effective manner. The Dental Program Manager makes scheduling adjustments necessary to improve or achieve optimal patient flow and monitors staff for safety and compliance related issues. This position must provide leadership in establishing and maintaining a professional and respectful environment that supports teamwork while promoting the dignity, privacy and confidentiality of patients, their families, co-workers and volunteers. The Dental Program Manager works closely with operations staff to support and achieve BACH’s goals and objectives including organizational quality and patient-centered care. This position has the ultimate authority to make changes in site operations, staff scheduling and discipline for all non-provider staff at that site, and works closely with Senior Clinical Leadership in resolving issues with site providers.

**Essential Responsibilities:**

Under the general direction of Director of Clinical Operations, the Dental Clinic Manager performs a variety of complex, professional, analytical, and confidential dental services. Duties include:

**Personnel Management, Training & Coordination:**

* Serve as liaison between Dental Director(s), Dental Supervisors, other clinical support staff, front desk, and administrative staff.
* Interview, hire, train, supervise, and evaluate clinic personnel.
* Working under the direction of the Director of Clinical Operations, responsible for all activities at the particular site, including monitoring and addressing clinic flow issues to maintain smooth operations and allow staff to provide high quality and timely care and services to patients.
* Work with the scheduling team to manage the Provider schedules and make adjustments due to last minute time off requests to meet the number of patient visits needed to support goals and objectives for patient volume
* Make site staffing allocation decisions and adjustments when necessary, such as determining if too many staff are on hand or not enough staff is present
* Monitors staff and arranges for training and/or counseling when needed to meet customer service expectations
* Coordinate audit preparation at the site and serve as site point person during the audit
* Plan, evaluate, recommend and implement new initiatives when appropriate
* Select and hire employees according to established guidelines. Monitor, coach, develop and evaluate performance of staff on an ongoing basis in accordance with applicable performance standards.
* Oversee licensed clinical staff in adherence to programs, protocols, quality assurance guidelines and ensure licenses are in good standing.
* Coordinate dental providers and clinic personnel schedules.
* Coordinate and document staff trainings, continuing education and staff meetings.
* Review staff time for payroll.
* Maintain current personnel information, certifications, licensures, and staff health exams etc.
* Conduct performance reviews and competency evaluations.
* Prepare documentation for clinic audits.
* Work to reach assigned quality metric, and implement interventions, as necessary, based upon productivity and compliance rate reports.

* Maintain inventory logs, storage areas, crash cart, and emergency equipment.
* Arrange for routine equipment servicing and prompt repairs when needed.

* Follow all safety procedures and report unsafe conditions to ensure an injury-free work environment.
* Use appropriate ergonomic measures to reduce risk of work-related injuries.
* Collaborate in department investigations and incident reporting including worker’s compensation.

* This job has supervisory responsibilities; candidate must be able to work flexible schedules, including evenings and weekends-

* Other tasks and projects as assigned by Directors of Clinic Services

* Attend webinars, workshops, training and/or meetings, as requested
* Perform special project research and data collection activities, as requested
* Collaborate with Outreach department with community events, as appropriate

jobs.title: Technical Customer Success Manager
jobs.description:
**About us**
------------

MintMCP helps companies put agents to work safely. We exist to help companies do more of their work with agents, and we build the infrastructure that makes a company's own work runnable by them. Our product gives those agents governed access to company data and tools. That has to start from trust.

Before agents can touch Slack, GitHub, Jira, Snowflake, internal databases, or production systems, you need to know what they can reach, what they did, and why they were allowed to do it. Most people carry far more permissions than any single task needs. If an agent uses your token directly, it inherits all of them. MintMCP scopes that access down to exactly what an agent needs to do its job and captures the data flows and audit logs security teams need. From there we are building the rest of the agent stack: connectors, monitoring, sandboxing, long-running agents, and memory, with the goal of becoming the system a company's work runs on.

We work in person in the San Francisco Bay Area. The structure is flat and the market moves fast, so you have a lot of latitude over what you work on and how.

We are AI-native. Everyone uses Claude and Codex every day, and we have more agents than employees. They run in Slack alongside the team and handle sales, marketing, deal ops, and engineering on the same gateway we sell to customers, and we are building an entire company operating system around them.

Since launching in February 2026, we have grown to 50+ paying customers, with strong inbound demand. Customers include Coursera, Arlo, and Braze. We are backed by Cowboy Ventures and Coatue, with angels including Frederic Kerrest (Okta), Michael Grinich (WorkOS), Andrej Karpathy, Jeff Dean, and Scott Belsky. Our founders are machine learning experts from Stanford, Berkeley, and CMU, with applied research at Google Brain and Waymo, and one co-founded Coursera.

**The job**
-----------

You own the customer once the deal is signed, all the way through. On day one that means building the mutual delivery plan with the customer: what success looks like, who does what, and by when. You drive onboarding, get the product live against real use cases, and stay close as usage grows. You are the person the customer trusts to make their rollout work.

From there you own the whole arc. You track account health, run the check-ins and business reviews, catch problems before they become risks, and pull in engineering or the founders when a customer needs more than you can give them alone. You own renewals, and you find and grow expansion, more teams, more agents, more of the company's work running on us. When something is on fire, you are the one who owns getting it resolved.

You'll also push in both directions. On the customer side, that means telling them when what they've asked for isn't what they need, and reframing it against what we've seen work elsewhere. Internally, it means advocating for your customers clearly and directly to the founders — while weighing what they want against what the company needs to prioritize. We'd rather you argue with us than quietly agree with a customer.

You are our first dedicated post-sales hire, so you also build the function. You turn what works into a repeatable motion: the delivery plan template, health scoring, the review rhythm, the handoff from sales. As the customer base grows, you help decide who we hire next and grow into leading customer success. The role is in person, with travel to meet customers.

**About you**
-------------

* You are exceptional with customers. People trust you quickly, and you keep a rollout on track without being told to. This is the core of the job.
* You have owned customer relationships end to end, in customer success, account management, consulting, or a client-delivery role.
* You can run a plan and drive it to an outcome across a customer's team, aligning stakeholders, tracking commitments, and keeping momentum.
* You are comfortable in technical conversations without being an engineer. You can hold your own with a technical buyer, explain what the product does and why it matters, and know when to pull in the team for the deep end. You do not write config or debug integrations.
* You have carried retention and expansion, or have the commercial instinct to, and can point to relationships you kept and grew.
* You have built structure where there was none, playbooks, templates, cadences, and you would rather build the motion than inherit one.
* You are calm under pressure and own the outcome when a customer is unhappy.
* You are AI-native, or will get there fast, and are genuinely curious about AI, agents, and how companies adopt them.
* You move fast without a lot of process, and you want to grow into leading a team.

**Bonus**
---------

* AI solutions engineer or forward-deployed engineer background.
* You've sold to or supported technical and engineering buyers.
* Experience with enterprise rollouts where security review, procurement, and multi-threading are part of the relationship.
* Comfort representing the company in person: business reviews, dinners, and on-site meetings with technical and security leaders.

**What we offer**
-----------------

* Competitive base, variable, and significant equity.
* Full ownership of your accounts, with room to build the function and grow into leadership.
* Direct access to the CEO, customers, and product decisions.
* Health benefits, on a team that puts family and health first.

*Prefer to have your agent apply? Point it at* *https://www.mintmcp.com/hiring/mcp*
