**About Lumentum**

Lumentum is a global leader in photonic technologies that power AI infrastructure, cloud data centers, telecommunications, industrial manufacturing, and sensing applications. As AI drives unprecedented demand for bandwidth, speed, and energy efficiency, our optical networking solutions enable the world's largest cloud providers to build the next generation of AI and cloud infrastructure.

With nearly 50 years of innovation, Lumentum delivers industry-leading lasers, optical components, and photonic solutions that connect people, businesses, and AI systems at massive scale. Headquartered in San Jose, California, we operate globally through world-class research, manufacturing, and customer support organizations.

This role provides the opportunity to lead strategic engagements with the world's largest hyperscale cloud providers and help shape the future of AI networking and optical connectivity.

**Position Overview**

As a Strategic Account Manager – Cloud and AI, you will be responsible for developing and growing strategic relationships with leading hyperscale cloud customers. You will drive design wins, long-term business growth, and executive engagement while working cross-functionally with Product Line Management, Engineering, Operations, Marketing, and Executive Leadership. This is a highly visible role supporting the rapid expansion of AI infrastructure and next-generation optical networking technologies.

**Job Responsibilities**

* Serve as the primary commercial interface for assigned hyperscale cloud customers, developing executive-level relationships while driving day-to-day business execution.
* Develop and execute account strategies to achieve revenue growth, design wins, and long-term strategic partnerships.
* Drive customer requirements internally and coordinate cross-functional teams to ensure successful customer engagements and exceptional customer satisfaction.
* Identify and develop new business opportunities across AI infrastructure, optical networking, and next-generation cloud architectures.
* Lead commercial negotiations including pricing, long-term supply agreements (LTAs), capacity planning, and strategic contracts.
* Manage complex, multi-year sales opportunities from early technology engagement through production deployment.
* Build trusted relationships from engineering organizations through executive leadership within strategic customer accounts.
* Develop accurate revenue forecasts and manage CRM, sales funnel activity, backlog, and business reviews.
* Collaborate closely with Sales Leadership, Product Line Management, Field Applications Engineering, Business Units, Operations, and Executive Leadership to secure new design wins and maximize customer success.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Physics, Computer Science, Business, or a related discipline. An advanced degree is a plus.
* **8+ years** of successful technical sales or account management experience within the semiconductor, optical networking, or data center infrastructure industry.
* Strong understanding of AI infrastructure, cloud networking, optical interconnects, and data center architecture.
* Demonstrated success managing complex strategic accounts and multi-million-dollar business opportunities.
* Excellent communication, presentation, negotiation, and executive relationship management skills.
* Strong analytical and organizational skills with the ability to influence cross-functional teams and executive stakeholders.
* Self-motivated with the ability to work independently in a fast-paced, global organization.

* **Candidates must possess at least two (2) of the following:** Direct experience selling optical networking products, including optical transceivers, lasers, coherent optics, silicon photonics, optical components, or related technologies. Experience selling directly to hyperscale cloud providers, including Microsoft, Amazon Web Services (AWS), Meta, Oracle, or other major cloud operators. Established relationships with decision makers within Microsoft, AWS, Meta, Oracle, or comparable hyperscale cloud customers.

* Experience supporting AI infrastructure, cloud networking, or high-performance computing platforms.
* Experience negotiating long-term supply agreements (LTAs), strategic commercial partnerships, and complex customer contracts.

**Our Mission:**

6sense's mission is to multiply what matters: growth, retention, and efficiency. We envision a future where companies, teams and people reach their full potential.

**Our People:**

People are the heart and soul of 6sense. We serve with passion and purpose. We live by our Being 6sense values of Win as One Team, Stay Curious, Do The Right Thing, Own the Outcome, and Create Belonging. Every 6sensor plays a part in deﬁning the future of our industry-leading technology. 6sense is a place where difference-makers roll up their sleeves, take risks, act with integrity, and measure success by the value we create for our customers. We want 6sense to be the best chapter of your career.

**About the Role**

6sense is seeking a Sr. Customer Success Manager, Advertising to help customers get measurable value from their advertising programs and grow their use of 6sense Advertising over time. In this post-sale role, you'll serve as the trusted advisor for a portfolio of advertising customers - guiding onboarding, activation, adoption, campaign success, value realization, and renewal readiness.

You'll partner closely with customers and internal teams to connect business goals to audience strategy, campaign performance, and clear next steps. You'll also help identify opportunities to expand advertising usage by building the customer success foundation that makes growth possible.

**What** **You'll** **Do**

* Own post-sale success for a portfolio of 6sense Advertising customers, ensuring clear goals, success plans, risks, and next steps.
* Advise customers on audience strategy, campaign structure, targeting, channel mix, budget allocation, measurement, and optimization.
* Partner with Campaign Operations, Professional Services, Product, Support, Sales, and Account teams to deliver a coordinated customer experience.

jobs.title: Patient account manager
jobs.description:
**About Serova**

Serova is building a fast-growing clinical network for its personalised cancer vaccine programme. Each vaccine is made for the individual patient from their own samples and given in partnership with their treating physician. We run the whole process for patients and their oncologists, from initial review through treatment and follow-up.

**The role**

We're looking for a Patient Account Manager to own each patient's experience from sign-up through to administration and follow-up. You'll be the main point of contact for the patient, their family, their physician and, where separate, the treatment sponsor-investigator. You'll answer their questions and keep every step on track.

Success looks like an excellent experience for every patient in our care, and a patient journey that runs smoothly and on time.

**What you'll do**

* Guide new patients and families through sign-up, consent paperwork, records requests and what to expect at each stage
* Coordinate sample collection and shipping with the patient's physician, pathology labs and sequencing partners, and track each sample through to results and analysis
* Keep patients, families and physicians regularly updated on sequencing, manufacturing and administration dates
* Answer non-clinical questions yourself, and quickly pass clinical or medical questions to our nursing, medical or scientific team
* Keep accurate, confidential records of each patient's status, communications and outstanding actions
* Arrange practical support such as travel, scheduling and help with financial-access questions

**Your first few months**

* Get to know Serova's personalised cancer vaccine programme end to end, from both our side and the patient's
* Take over communication and day-to-day management of patients already on the programme
* Set up patient trackers and make sure every outstanding action and question is dealt with

**What we're looking for**

* Experience in a patient-facing coordination role, such as patient services, case management, care coordination or clinical-trial patient support, ideally in oncology. If you've done similar work outside a clinical setting and have the right mindset, we'd still like to hear from you.
* A track record of managing complex, time-sensitive logistics across several external parties, such as clinics, labs and couriers
* Clear, compassionate communication with patients and families during a difficult time, and confidence working with physicians and their teams
* Careful handling of confidential health information, with working knowledge of HIPAA
* Good judgement about which questions to answer yourself and which to escalate to clinical colleagues

**Nice to have**

* Experience with personalised or autologous therapy programmes
* Specimen chain of custody
* Expanded-access or clinical-trial enrolment
* Patient CRM or case-management systems
* Familiarity with Good Clinical Practice (GCP)

**Details**

* **Location:** San Francisco, California
* **Type:** Full-time
* **Salary:** $100,000 to $130,000

Questions? Email clinical@serova.bio

Company background

World Class Health was built to solve one of healthcare’s most expensive and overlooked problems: when employees face high-stakes medical decisions, they often lack access to trusted, high-quality care at an affordable cost.

Traditional healthcare systems force patients to navigate rising costs, fragmented care, limited visibility into provider quality, and unclear out-of-pocket exposure, often during the most vulnerable moments of their lives. WCH exists to change that. Through our medically led Global Centers of Excellence platform, AI-driven insights, transparent provider relationships, and concierge care navigation, we connect patients to top 1% care globally while helping employers reduce healthcare costs and improve outcomes.

WCH focuses on high-cost specialty care episodes including orthopedics, spine, cardiac care, oncology, imaging, infusion, and complex surgical needs. Our model combines predictive analytics, proactive outreach, nurse-led care management, direct provider contracting, and transparent bundled pricing to help employers lower costs while improving the patient experience.

Role: Care Navigator (USA)Role Description

We’re looking for a Care Navigator to help members simplify how they navigate imaging and other diagnostic, surgical, and clinical needs.

You’ll work alongside automated outreach and clinical navigation teams, stepping in when a human conversation, persistence, or judgment is needed. Members you’ll speak with are US-based, so this role calls for fluent, natural English on the phone.

This is also an early-stage operation. We have playbooks, scripts, and SOPs — but they will evolve. We want someone who can execute the process well while also noticing where it can be better.

**What you’ll do**

* Proactively call members and introduce the World Class Health benefit
* Quickly establish credibility and trust during outbound calls
* Explain benefits in simple, member-friendly language, including coverage, expected cost, facility options, and next steps
* Follow up with members by phone, text, and email to keep cases moving
* Manage a caseload of members at different stages of the engagement and scheduling process
* Accurately document outreach, conversations, and outcomes in Salesforce
* Follow established scripts and workflows while using good judgment when a conversation does not fit the script
* Identify patterns in member behavior and share feedback to help optimize the product
* Test new messaging, outreach approaches, and workflows as the program evolves

**What we’re looking for**

* Bachelor’s degree, or an Associate’s degree combined with healthcare or operations experience
* Experience working remotely in a fast paced environment
* Comfortable making outbound calls to people you have never spoken with before
* Strong verbal communication skills and the ability to build rapport quickly
* Able to explain healthcare and benefit information clearly without sounding scripted
* Highly organized and comfortable managing a pipeline or caseload with multiple follow-ups
* Curious and willing to experiment rather than assuming the current process is the final process
* Comfortable working in an environment where priorities, scripts, and SOPs will evolve as we learn
* High-energy, proactive, and willing to jump into problems rather than wait for someone else to solve them
* Sound judgment about when to solve something yourself and when to escalate

**Nice to have**

You’ll probably enjoy this role if you like talking to people, solving problems in real time, and figuring out how to make a process work better.

jobs.description:
**ABOUT MARINHEALTH**  
Are you looking for a place where you are empowered to bring innovation to reality? Join MarinHealth, an integrated, independent healthcare system with deep roots throughout the North Bay. With a world-class physician and clinical team, an affiliation with UCSF Health, an ever-expanding network of clinics, and a new state-of-the-art hospital, MarinHealth is growing quickly. MarinHealth comprises MarinHealth Medical Center, a 327-bed hospital in Greenbrae, and 55 primary care and specialty clinics in Marin, Sonoma, and Napa Counties. We attract healthcare’s most talented trailblazers who appreciate having the best of both worlds: the pioneering medicine of an academic medical center combined with an independent hospital's personalized, caring touch.

MarinHealth is already realizing the benefits of impressive growth and has consistently earned high praise and accolades, including being Named One of the Top 250 Hospitals Nationwide by Healthgrades, receiving a 5-star Ranking for Overall Hospital Quality from the Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services, and being named the Best Hospital in San Francisco/Marin by Bay Area Parent, among others.

**Company:**

Prima Medical Foundation dba MarinHealth Medical Network

**Work Shift:**

Day Shift (United States of America)

**Scheduled Weekly Hours:**

40

**Job Description Summary:**

The Sterile Processing Educator and Trainer oversees all aspects of sterile processing operations within the Medical Network. This critical role ensures the effective cleaning, sterilization, and distribution of medical instruments while upholding strict compliance with regulatory standards and infection control protocols.  
  
The role involves managing day-to-day operations, building and maintaining vendor relationships for surgical instrument procurement, and creating comprehensive training programs for sterile processing staff. Additionally, responsibilities include leading quality control efforts, ensuring adherence to compliance requirements, and promoting a culture of excellence and continuous improvement.

**Job Requirements, Prerequisites and Essential Functions:**

Pay Range:

$33.25 - $39.50 - $44.71

**Essential Functions and Responsibilities:**
---------------------------------------------

**Sterile Processing Management:**
----------------------------------

* Oversee the daily operations of the sterile processing areas across the Network, ensuring compliance with infection control standards, regulatory guidelines, and safety protocols.
* Monitor and maintain the cleanliness, functionality, and availability of medical instruments, ensuring proper sterilization techniques are consistently followed.
* Ensure proper tracking and inventory of all sterilized equipment, tools, and supplies.

**Vendor Management & Instrumentation Procurement:**

* Develop and maintain strong relationships with external vendors to manage the procurement of high-quality surgical instruments and equipment.
* Coordinate the ordering, delivery, and inventory management of instruments and sterilization supplies, ensuring that SPD needs are met in a timely manner.
* Evaluate vendor performance regularly, negotiating pricing and contract terms to ensure cost-efficiency without compromising on quality or safety standards.

**Staff Training & Development:**

* Lead the design, implementation, and ongoing evaluation of sterile processing staff training programs, ensuring all team members are well-versed in sterile techniques, equipment handling, and regulatory requirements.
* Conduct regular performance evaluations and provide guidance to SPD staff on best practices in sterilization procedures and safety protocols.
* Promote a culture of continuous learning and improvement by facilitating regular in-service training sessions and ensuring team members are up-to-date on the latest industry standards and innovations.

**Quality Control & Compliance:**

* Oversee routine quality control checks on sterilization processes and equipment, ensuring all procedures are in compliance with healthcare regulations.
* Work closely with the infection control team to monitor for any potential risks and take corrective actions when needed.
* Ensure adherence to accreditation and certification standards related to sterilization practices.

**Preferred Skills:**

* Proven experience in sterile processing and instrument management
* Strong knowledge of infection control procedures, sterilization methods, and healthcare regulations.
* Experience in vendor management and contract negotiations for medical instrumentation procurement.
* Excellent communication and leadership skills, with a focus on team development and training.
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.

**Qualifications:**

**Education:**

* High school diploma or General Educational Development (GED) certificate required.
* Bachelor's degree in Healthcare Management, Nursing, or a related field (preferred).

**Licenses/Certifications:**

* Certification in Sterile Processing (CRCST, CIS, or similar) is required.
* BLS Certification (American Heart Association) required.

**Experience:**

* A minimum of three years related experience required.
* Re-processing/ procedural experience required.
* Proven experience in sterile processing and instrument management
* Strong knowledge of infection control procedures, sterilization methods, and healthcare regulations.
* Experience in vendor management and contract negotiations for medical instrumentation procurement.
* Excellent communication and leadership skills, with a focus on team development and training.
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.

Qualified applicants with disabilities may request reasonable accommodation during the application process by contacting Human Resources at 415-925-7040 or TalentAcquisition@mymarinhealth.org.

jobs.title: Operations Associate (Pharmacy)
jobs.description:
Healthcare is broken at the first step: patients can't find the right care, understand what it costs, or access the medications they need. Mochi Health is fixing this.

We're building an AI-driven marketplace that makes healthcare discoverable—connecting patients to the right providers, transparent pharmacy pricing, and affordable medications. Over the past few years, we've grown rapidly by combining clinical expertise with technology that actually works for real people, not just hospital systems.

Our platform does what legacy healthcare can't: it gives patients transparent pricing before they pay, personalized medication management that follows them across providers, and long-term access to their own medical records. We're proving that healthcare can be more affordable, more human, and far more intuitive than what exists today.

Join a team that's rebuilding healthcare from the patient up. At Mochi Health, you'll work alongside people who value bold thinking, inclusive collaboration, and getting meaningful work into the world. If you want to do the most impactful work of your career, this is where to do it.

**About The Role**
------------------

We're looking for independently driven and detail-oriented individuals to join our Pharmacy Operations team. In this role, you'll sit at the center of how medications move from prescription to a patient's doorstep, keeping fulfillment accurate, fast, and reliable. You'll partner closely with our Pharmacy, Clinical, Care, Product, and Data teams to optimize dispensing workflows, strengthen pharmacy partner relationships, and use data to continuously improve the patient experience.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

* Optimize pharmacy fulfillment workflows by identifying inefficiencies, implementing solutions, and continuously improving the path from prescription to delivery.
* Monitor and resolve fulfillment exceptions, including delayed, rejected, or stuck orders, prior authorization holds, and inventory or stock issues, so patients receive their medications on time.
* Analyze operational data using SQL and other tools to track pharmacy KPIs such as turnaround time, fill rate, and error rate, surface key insights, and drive data-informed decisions.
* Act as a key liaison with pharmacy partners and vendors, ensuring issues are addressed quickly, feedback is gathered, and service levels are met.
* Collaborate cross-functionally with Pharmacy, Clinical, Care, Product, and Data teams to develop strategies that improve the patient medication experience.
* Support innovation in pharmacy operations by researching best practices and industry trends to help shape Mochi's fulfillment roadmap.
* Manage and update operational content, including partner communication, training resources, SOPs, and workflows.
* Foster a team-first mindset: humility, collaboration, and partnership are key.

**Who You Are**
---------------

* 0 to 2 years of experience.
* Bachelor's Degree in STEM or a related field.
* Comfortable working full-time, in-office in our downtown San Francisco office.
* Exceptional written and verbal communication skills. You know how, when, and what to communicate with confidence and clarity.
* Experience working across teams and building relationships with both internal and external stakeholders.
* Analytical and detail-oriented, with a proactive approach to solving problems.
* A strong communicator who thrives in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.
* Interest in pharmacy, healthcare operations, or supply chain is a plus.

The base salary for this full-time position ranges from **$100,000 to $130,000 including benefits and stock options**. The salary range listed in each job posting represents the minimum and maximum targets for new hire salaries across all locations. Actual compensation within this range is determined by various factors, such as job-related skills, experience, relevant education or training, and location.

**Life at Mochi**
-----------------

At Mochi, we believe your best work happens when you feel your best—so we've designed an environment that fuels your creativity, supports your growth, and makes every day exciting.

**✨ Comprehensive Health Coverage** –Robust medical, dental, and vision insurance to support your health—so you can feel your best, in and out of work.

**Financial Security** –Plan for your future with a 401(k) plus company matching and fully covered life insurance—because peace of mind matters.

**Time to Recharge** –Enjoy unlimited PTO, generous company holidays, and true flexibility. We trust you to take the time you need to rest, reset, and thrive.

**Wellness First** –From weekly mindfulness sessions to group workouts and fitness perks, your physical and mental health are top priority.

**Daily Fuel** –Our office is stocked with an *unlimited espresso and matcha bar*, plus delicious lunch served **five days a week**. No sad desk lunches here.

**Connection & Community** –We value real relationships. From team lunches and office hangs to offsite retreats, we create space to connect and collaborate.

**High-Impact Work** –Be part of shaping the future of digital healthcare during an exciting period of growth and innovation.

**Competitive Compensation** –We offer a top-of-market salary and a generous equity package—because you deserve to share in the upside you help create.

**‍ World-Class Team** –Join a team of thoughtful, driven professionals across engineering, product, clinical, operations, and beyond—each bringing excellence and empathy to the table.

**Profitable & Explosive Growth** – Our growth is like trying to drink from a firehose while riding a rocket, as we commit to decisions that ensure long-term success, stability, and the well-being of our team and customers—all without the constraints of VC funding.

**Company Description**

At Lucile Packard Children’s Hospital Stanford, we know world-renowned care begins with world-class caring. That's why we combine advanced technologies and breakthrough discoveries with family-centered care. It's why we provide our caregivers with continuing education and state-of-the-art facilities, like the newly remodeled Lucile Packard Children's Hospital Stanford. And it's why we need caring, committed people on our team - like you. Join us on our mission to heal humanity, one child and family at a time.  
  
**Job ID:** P140091-2660347

 **Job Description**

**JOB SUMMARY**

This paragraph summarizes the general nature, level and purpose of the job.

Case Managers are licensed nursing professionals responsible for coordinating continuum of care and discharge planning activities for a caseload of assigned patients. Major responsibilities include coordinating all facets of a patient's admission/discharge; performing utilization review activities, including review of patient charts for timeliness of services as well as appropriate utilization of services; and ensuring optimum use of resources, service delivery, and compliance with external review agencies' requirements. Case Managers act as consultants to the clinical team, service lines, and other departments regarding patient assessment and patient care and participate in program development and quality improvement initiatives. In their role, Case Managers, by applying guidelines and collaborating with multidisciplinary teams, influence and direct the delivery and quality of patient care. A hospital-based case management system has as its primary goal to ensure the most appropriate use of services by patients and, toward that end, to avoid duplication and misuse of medical services, control costs by reducing inefficient services, and improve the effectiveness of care delivery. Objectives are to facilitate timely discharge; prompt, efficient use of resources; achievement of expected outcomes; collaborative practice; coordination of care across the continuum; and performance/quality improvement activities that lead to optimal patient outcomes. A Case Manager differs from other roles in professional nursing/health care practice in that it is not intended to provide direct patient care; rather, a Case Manager will be assigned to specific patients to ensure that the medical services and treatments required are accomplished in the most financially and clinically efficient manner.

**ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS**

The essential functions listed are typical examples of work performed by positions in this job classification. They are not designed to contain or be interpreted as a comprehensive inventory of all duties, tasks, and responsibilities. Employees may also perform other duties as assigned.

Employees must abide by all Joint Commission Requirements including but not limited to sensitivity to cultural diversity, patient care, patient rights and ethical treatment, safety and security of physical environments, emergency management, teamwork, respect for others, participation in ongoing education and training, communication and adherence to safety and quality programs, sustaining compliance with National Patient Safety Goals, and licensure and health screenings.

Must perform all duties and responsibilities in accordance with the hospital's policies and procedures, including its Service Standards and its Code of Conduct.

DISCHARGE PLANNING

* Coordinates and facilitates timely implementation of discharge plans for assigned patients with complex needs in collaboration with other interdisciplinary team members; arranges follow-up care as appropriate.

EDUCATION/CONSULTATION

* Acts as an educational resource and provides consultation to patients and their families, hospital medical personnel regarding the discharge planning process and applicable regulatory requirements; educates the staff on case management; and provides specific information related to case types.

LEAD WORK

* May lead the work of administrative/clinical support staff responsible for assisting with case management for an assigned patient caseload.

OTHER

* Participates in department program planning, goal setting, systems development and process improvement; participates in department and hospital committees and task forces; develops and maintains documentation of findings, discharge arrangements, and actions taken according to departmental guidelines; prepares and maintains records as required; collects, analyzes and reports on data for utilization, quality improvement, compliance, and other areas as assigned.

PATIENT ASSESSMENT/PLAN OF CARE

* Functions as a resource to and collaborates with physicians, social workers, nurses, and other interdisciplinary team members to assess, plan, and coordinate patient care needs and/or performs patient assessment and develops a plan of care to assure consistent, timely, and appropriate care is provided in a patient-focused manner.

jobs.description:
### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 11 years of experience in management consulting, product management and strategy, or analytics in a technology company.
* Experience providing data-driven decision support and advice to executive stakeholders.
* Experience working with and analyzing data, and managing multiple projects.
* Experience with SQL and spreadsheet based analysis.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* MBA degree.
* Experience in an analytically-intensive role, such as management consulting, investment banking, business intelligence, data science, or corporate strategy and operations.
* Experience working with consumer-facing software products, product teams, and engineering teams.
* Experience in leveraging AI solutions for data analysis.
* Experience with people management.
* Exceptional communication skills with a proven ability to create compelling narratives.

**About the job**
-----------------

Product and Business Strategy Leaders bring together teams across Google’s functions to help products execute optimally. Our team pushes Google to scale at key points that refine our products and infrastructure by executing efficiently, bringing solid business sense and sound judgment, and working effectively across organizational lines.  
  
Our roles often include components of strategy (e.g. analyzing and understanding new trends in the industry, building business plans), operations (e.g. running the cadence of organizations, connecting the operating lines between our functions), and communications. Our team partners with senior leadership to run important functions that cross-cut our existing organizations and deliver high impact projects. We help Engineers, PMs, UX, and all of our other functions to build amazing products that delight our users, and then get those products into their hands.

YouTube’s ecosystem is constantly growing and evolving. We believe it's critical to use data to run our business and drive the decisions we make. Our Product Strategy and Operations Team partners with Product and Engineering leaders to enable better decisions and faster execution. In this role, you’re expected to help drive YouTube growth strategy through investigative insights, and operational excellence.

At YouTube, we believe that everyone deserves to have a voice, and that the world is a better place when we listen, share, and build community through our stories. We work together to give everyone the power to share their story, explore what they love, and connect with one another in the process. Working at the intersection of cutting-edge technology and boundless creativity, we move at the speed of culture with a shared goal to show people the world. We explore new ideas, solve real problems, and have fun — and we do it all together.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.
  
  
US: $176000 - $256000 (USD) + 20% bonus target + equity + benefits  
  
Learn more about benefits at Google.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Work with the YouTube Viewer leadership team to identify and prioritize medium and longer term opportunities, Set Annual and Quarterly Goals (OKRs) and determine how we measure success.
* Analyze, understand and communicate how YouTube is performing against our goals and identify emerging insights and trends with our leadership team.
* Run our weekly “health of the business” forum with our Product, Engineering, and Business leadership teams.
* Partner with our Data Science team to prioritize and execute quantitative analyses and advanced modeling that deliver insights.
* Manage the viewer growth product strategy and operations team and help with day-to-day direction, guidance and prioritization.

Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. jobs.description:

Looking for a place that values your unique talents? Discover Stryker's award-winning culture.  
We are proud to offer you our total rewards package which includes bonuses, healthcare, insurance benefits, retirement programs, wellness programs, as well as service and performance awards – not to mention various social and recreational activities, all of which are location specific.

### **Job description**

jobs.title: Direct Sales Enablement Specialist
jobs.description:
Cleaned Document
  
**About the role and team**  
  
Sales Enablement at Uber means navigating ambiguity, earning trust fast, and solving problems that don't come with a script. In this role, you will be the primary architect of the skills, knowledge, and processes that empower our sales teams to move the real world. You aren't just delivering training; you are building the foundation for a high-performing commercial engine that operates at a massive, global scale across fast-evolving business lines like Uber Eats, Uber for Business, and our incubation ventures.
  
  
You will lead high-leverage programs in an environment where change is constant and the stakes are high. This requires a leader who can move fluidly between high-level strategy and hands-on implementation, bridging the gap between complex product roadmaps and real-world sales execution. If you lead with clarity, thrive in challenge, and are motivated by the measurable impact of learning on business growth, this is where you'll make your mark.
  
  
**What you'll do**

* Own the end-to-end design and execution of sales enablement roadmaps, including new hire onboarding, continuing education, and commercial skill certification.
* Diagnose systemic sales productivity gaps using data-driven insights from Salesforce and conversational intelligence tools to design repeatable, performance-improving playbooks.
* Navigate cross-functional complexity by partnering with Sales, Ops, and Product teams to align enablement priorities with regional business goals and global strategies.
* Orchestrate organizational change by leading the rollout of new sales methodologies, tech stack optimizations, and product launches to a diverse, global sales force.
* Champion a "learner-first" culture, delivering engaging in-person and virtual training sessions that simplify the complex and drive measurable, lasting behavioral change.
* Communicate with purpose to senior leadership, synthesizing program impact and sales performance metrics into clear narratives and strategic recommendations.

**Basic Qualifications**

* Minimum 4 years of experience in Sales Enablement, Sales Training, or Sales Operations.
* Proven track record in customer-facing sales roles or coaching frontline sales staff in a high-growth B2B tech environment.
* Hands-on experience designing and delivering comprehensive training programs, including onboarding and skill-development playbooks.
* Proficiency in sales enablement technologies (e.g., Salesforce, Gong, Highspot) and building reporting from CRM data.
* Demonstrated ability to manage complex, multi-workstream projects with tight deadlines.
* Exceptional presentation and communication skills with the ability to influence without direct authority.
* Bachelor's degree

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Advanced knowledge of adult learning principles and instructional design for diverse audiences.
* Experience working in high-intensity startups or tech environments where priorities evolve rapidly.
* Mastery of stakeholder management, with the ability to build trust-based relationships across global time zones.
* Professional fluency in additional regional languages (e.g., Spanish, German, or Portuguese) where applicable.
* Experience leading sales events, offsites, or Sales Kickoff (SKO) planning.
Graduate degree or equivalent certification in Project Management (PMP) or Change Management.  

  
  
For Chicago, IL-based roles: The base salary range for this role is USD $113,000 per year - USD $126,000 per year.  
  
For New York City, NY-based roles: The base salary range for this role is USD $126,000 per year - USD $140,000 per year.  
  
For San Francisco, CA-based roles: The base salary range for this role is USD $126,000 per year - USD $140,000 per year.  
  
For all US locations, you will be eligible to participate in Uber's bonus program, and may be offered an equity award & other types of comp. All full-time employees are eligible to participate in a 401(k) plan. You will also be eligible for various benefits.  
  
**Ready to Ride?**  
  
This isn't the kind of place where you follow a playbook - it's where you help write one. If you're driven by impact, energized by challenge, and ready to shape how the world moves - we'd love to hear from you.  
  
You may be eligible for bonuses, equity, and other compensation, as well as a range of benefits. Explore our benefits.  
  
Offices remain key to collaboration and Uber's culture. Unless approved for full remote work, employees must spend at least 50% of their time in-office. Some roles, like those at greenlight hubs, require full-time in-office presence. Ask your Recruiter for details about this role's requirements.  
  
Uber is proud to be an Equal Opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, religion, national origin, disability, protected Veteran status, age, or any other characteristic protected by law. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing this form.

jobs.title: Learning & Development Specialist
jobs.description:
The Learning & Development (L&D) Specialist is responsible for designing, implementing, managing, and continuously improving learning programs that support associate growth, organizational effectiveness, and business objectives. This role owns the company's onboarding experience, collaborates with stakeholders to identify learning needs, develops engaging learning solutions, and manages programs from conception through evaluation.

The Learning & Development Specialist combines expertise in instructional design, program management, organizational development, and learning administration with a passion for creating impactful associate development experiences.

**Onboarding Program Management**

* Own and continuously enhance the end-to-end associate onboarding experience for new hires.
* Partner with HR, business leaders, and subject matter experts to ensure onboarding content remains current and aligned with business priorities.
* Manage onboarding schedules, communications, learning assignments, and program logistics.
* Evaluate onboarding effectiveness through feedback, participation metrics, and business outcomes, implementing improvements as needed.

**Learning Program Design & Development**

* Design, create, update, and maintain high-quality presentations, guides, videos, e-learning modules, facilitator materials, participant resources, job aids, and quick-reference tools.
* Translate complex information into practical, accessible, learner-centered content aligned with adult-learning principles, organizational standards, and Fremont Bank branding.
* Organize and maintain learning resources within the Learning Management System and approved shared-learning platforms.
* Support virtual, hybrid, and in-person learning delivery and troubleshoot routine learning-technology issues.
* Use approved AI-assisted content tools responsibly, validating accuracy, protecting confidential information, complying with licensing requirements, and applying appropriate human review.

**Organizational Development Support**

* Support organizational development initiatives that strengthen associate engagement, leadership capability, career development, talent readiness, and organizational effectiveness.
* Assist in the implementation of talent development programs and change management efforts.
* Partner with HR and business leaders to support a culture of continuous learning and growth.

**Program Management & Continuous Improvement**

* Manage multiple learning and development programs simultaneously, ensuring successful planning, execution, and delivery.
* Develop project plans, timelines, communication strategies, and implementation schedules.
* Coordinate resources, stakeholders, facilitators, and vendors to ensure program success.
* Establish and track key performance indicators (KPIs) to evaluate program effectiveness and impact.
* Recommend and implement enhancements based on data, stakeholder input, and best practices.

**Learning Administration**

* Maintain learning records, program documentation, and learning management system (LMS) data.
* Manage course enrollment, program communications, training calendars, and reporting.
* Ensure training materials and learning resources remain accurate and accessible.
* Support compliance and audit-related training requirements as needed.

**Vendor Management**

* Coordinate with external training providers, consultants, and learning partners.
* Assist with vendor selection, scheduling, contracting, invoicing, and program delivery.
* Evaluate vendor performance and learning outcomes to ensure quality and alignment with organizational needs.

**Learning & Development Support**

* Serve as a trusted partner to associates, managers, and HR colleagues regarding learning and development resources.
* Stay informed on emerging L&D trends, technologies, and industry best practices.
* Contribute to the ongoing development of the organization's learning strategy and associate development initiatives.
* Perform other duties and responsibilities as assigned.

  

* Bachelor’s degree in human resources, Organizational Development, Education, Business, Psychology, or related field.
* 3 plus years of experience in Learning & Development, Talent Development, Organizational Development, Human Resources, or a related function.
* Experience managing onboarding programs and employee development initiatives.
* Experience designing and delivering training content using instructional design methodologies.
* Experience managing projects and coordinating multiple stakeholders.
* Knowledge of adult learning theory and instructional design models (ADDIE, SAM, or similar).
* Experience with learning management systems (LMS) and virtual learning platforms.
* Familiarity with organizational development and talent management practices.
* Training, facilitation, or coaching certification preferred.

**Physical Requirements**

The physical requirements described below are representative of those that must be met to successfully perform the essential functions of this position, with or without reasonable accommodation.

* Ability to remain in a stationary position for extended periods (e.g., sitting or standing).
* Frequent use of a computer and other office equipment.
* Ability to communicate effectively with colleagues and customers.
* Occasionally move or lift items up to 10 pounds.

Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the position.

jobs.description:
Assistant Security Account Manager

**Overview**
------------

Company Overview:

Allied Universal®, North America’s leading security and facility services company, offers rewarding careers that provide you a sense of purpose. While working in a dynamic, welcoming, and collaborative workplace, you will be part of a team that contributes to a culture that positively impacts the communities and customers we serve.

**Job Description**
-------------------

Allied Universal is looking to hire an Assistant Account Manager. The Assistant Account Manager job is responsible for assisting the Account Manager with all supervisory, training and operations functions at the assigned post in accordance with post orders and client instructions, and following all internal procedures. To support and ensure success in this role, we provide a comprehensive, week-long management onboarding course designed to provide best practices, tools and guidance.

**RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Under the direction of the Account Manager, this position assists with the coordination of all aspects (technical and managerial) of executing the security contract at the assigned location. Assigns work tasks to Security Professionals and directs their work throughout the day
* This position is the first direct supervisory contact for shift supervisors (if applicable to site) or for Security Professionals, regarding performance, operations, and department needs. Responsible for supervising, motivating, coaching and training Also responsible for evaluating the work performance of Security Professionals and making recommendations regarding assignments
* Responsible for making sure that Post Order manual and all other post and training information is being properly maintained and updated, and that the Post is being properly maintained, cleaned and organized
* Assist the Account Manager in conducting interviews and evaluating new employees. Responsible for conducting on-the-job training, in coordination with Shift Supervisors, of new employees assigned to post, or when changes to post orders are made. This may include orientation to the post, review of post orders, routine responsibilities, and how to respond to emergency situations or specific client needs;
* Oversees all reports, logs and pass downs generated by and for the Security Department. Distributes communications and other information to Security Professionals at post as directed
* Manages and supervises all sub-units within the Security Department, such as fire control room, command center, and loading docks as applicable to job site. May generate work orders and attached paperwork for extra security coverage requests
* Responds to minor incidents (internal to Security Professionals and/or external to client location) that occur, ensuring appropriate action is taken, all reports are properly completed, and appropriate parties are notified in a timely manner
* Identifies any personnel problems occurring at posts, such as payroll issues, employee relations complaints or other concerns, and forward any such issues to Account Manager or Field Supervisor as appropriate. May be responsible for writing a report of the situation or assisting with an investigation, as directed by Account Manager, Branch Manager or Corporate HR Director
* Responsible for making recommendations for counseling and/or disciplinary action, including termination. May be responsible for administering counseling or disciplinary actions (may not make or initiate such decisions on his/her own, but may execute such actions at the specific direction of Account Manager with prior approval from Branch/Corporate HR management)
* Responds to client or site emergencies as they arise, including ensuring appropriate communication to Account Manager, Field Supervisor, Branch and/or Regional Manager. Responsible for maintaining positive client/security relationships through frequent tenant/client contact and support
* May occasionally perform Security Professional type job duties on an as-needed basis by standing post, but under no circumstances to exceed more than 50% of time in any given workweek.

**QUALIFICATIONS:**

* Minimum high school diploma or equivalent
* Minimum three (3) – five (5) years of professional-level experience required. Prior experience in the security industry, law enforcement and/or military required
* Must possess a valid state Guard License, or have applied and subsequently be issued such a license prior to employment. As a condition of employment, employee must successfully complete a background investigation and a post-offer/pre-employment drug/alcohol test. Additionally, as a condition of continued employment, employee must maintain current active status of Guard License at all times, and must carry the license at all times while on duty
* Driving Positions: must possess a valid Driver’s License with at least one year of driving experience, a clean driving record (no major violations within last 36 months, no more than 1 accident in last 24 months, no more than one minor moving violation in last 24 months), a minimum level of insurance as required by Company policy, and the ability to safely operate a vehicle required.
* Energetic and focused personality with a demonstrated ability to take initiative, successfully handle and prioritize multiple competing assignments and effectively manage deadlines. Demonstration of strong customer service orientation required, with ability to effectively resolve client issues in a professional and service-focused manner and to de-escalate situations before they become hostile or unpleasant required
* Professional, articulate and able to use good independent judgment and discretion
* Ability to train and coach others, and to effectively enforce post orders, security standards and company policies equitably and consistently

jobs.title: Program Delivery Governance Lead – Stars Enablement
jobs.description:
**Become a part of our caring community**
=========================================

Stars is an organization that is responsible for improving health outcomes and advancing the care experience of our members and provider partners through quality solutions. Stars is committed to caring for our customers and delivering high plan quality as rated by the Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services (CMS).

The Program Delivery Governance Lead for the Stars Enablement Team will be responsible for identifying, developing, and implementing governance structures and meeting forums that drive improvements in Stars measure performance and organizational effectiveness. Working closely with a small team, this role will continuously enhance and lead governance processes, ensuring alignment with organizational objectives and regulatory requirements. The Program Delivery Lead addresses issues of diverse scope and complexity, applying independent judgment to deliver results that support Healthy Quality and Stars initiatives.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Own and enhance the governance process for the Stars organization, as part of the governance team. And with leadership input and support
* Strategically design, implement, and maintain governance structures and forums to drive improvement in Stars and quality metrics.
* Coordinate with finance partners to help organize the Stars OpEx and Admin budgets
* Lead governance meetings, facilitate decision-making, and ensure effective documentation and communication of outcomes.
* Review, analyze, and report on the results of programs and governance activities, providing actionable insights to stakeholders.
* Advise executives and senior leadership on governance-related matters, contributing to the development of functional and segment-specific strategies.
* Implement and monitor changes to governance processes, ensuring continuous improvement and adaptability to organizational needs.
* Exercise independent judgment and decision-making on complex issues with minimal supervision.
* Collaborate across business units to promote alignment, share best practices, and drive accountability for governance standards.
* Maintain awareness of industry trends, regulatory requirements, and best practices related to governance and Stars program management.
* Effectively identifies key decision points and understands when to properly escalate and ensure the right levels of leadership are present for decision making.
* Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment and proactively communicating/pivoting when changes to agenda or audience members present for decision making are needed.
* Remain organized while managing multiple initiatives and hold DRI’s accountable to follow-through on key action items/asks from Senior leadership.
* Regularly interfaces with executives, leadership, and stakeholders at all levels.

* Demonstrated comfort working with budgets and financial resources
* Experience leading cross-functional teams, managing complex projects, and driving organizational change
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills
* Demonstrated ability to articulate ideas effectively in both written and oral forms
* Experience presenting to large groups and engage senior stakeholders

* Knowledge and/or experience within the Stars Organization, Risk Adjustment and/or Provider

jobs.title: Global Talent Operations Process & Enablement Analyst
jobs.description:
**Job Description**

The Global Talent Operations Process & Enablement Analyst improves the processes, tools, governance, and ways of working that help Global Talent operate effectively at scale.
  
You’ll identify opportunities to reduce friction, recommend practical solutions, and help implement and sustain improvements. This role combines process expertise, stakeholder partnership, thoughtful governance, and the responsible use of AI and automation to improve how work gets done. Your work will help GM deliver consistent, high-quality development experiences for employees while enabling Global Talent teams to focus on strategic priorities.
  
  
**What you’ll do**  
Improve processes and ways of working

* Analyze workflows, handoffs, and stakeholder experiences to identify root causes and opportunities for improvement.
* Lead moderate-scope improvements from discovery through implementation, iteration, and sustainment.
* Create and maintain process maps, standard work, job aids, intake paths, role definitions, and governance documentation.
* Use data and feedback to monitor adoption, measure effectiveness, resolve issues, and prioritize improvements.

Enable localization and translation

* Improve the intake, prioritization, routing, review, approval, and delivery of localized and translated learning and talent-management content.
* Coordinate content owners, subject-matter experts, vendors, tools, and stakeholders to improve quality, turnaround time, consistency, reuse, and self-service.
* Clarify trade-offs and establish practical guidance that makes global delivery more efficient and scalable.

Strengthen onboarding

* Design and maintain onboarding experiences that help direct and contract employees contribute quickly.
* Improve access to tools, information, and working connections while clarifying ownership, handoffs, and expectations.
* Use feedback and data to improve onboarding consistency, usefulness, and scalability.

Optimize information management

* Improve Records and Information Management and Information Lifecycle Management practices across Global Talent.
* Clarify information ownership, classification, retention, access, and lifecycle expectations.
* Improve findability, reduce content sprawl, and translate requirements into practical, sustainable ways of working.

Partner across Global Talent

* Support centralized Global Talent processes and services by providing guidance, triage, and routing.
* Partner with stakeholders to clarify needs, evaluate options, resolve trade-offs, and coordinate dependencies and decisions.
* Build trust through transparent communication, sound judgment, and reliable follow-through.

Use technology thoughtfully

* Identify repetitive, inconsistent, manual, or high-friction work that may benefit from process changes, AI, or automation.
* Explore and test practical solutions within privacy, security, quality, compliance, and governance expectations.
* Define appropriate human review, decision points, and escalation paths where context, empathy, judgment, or accountability matter.
Evaluate results, document learnings, and help implement solutions that deliver meaningful value.  

**What success looks like**

* Global Talent processes are clear, documented, adopted, and maintained.
* Localization and translation work is efficient, consistent, resource-conscious, and scalable.
* Direct and contract employees receive timely access to the information, tools, and connections they need to become productive.
* Information is easier to find, manage, retain, and use appropriately.
* Stakeholders experience less duplication, rework, ambiguity, and manual coordination.
* Improvements produce measurable gains in efficiency, quality, consistency, or stakeholder experience.
Technology-enabled solutions are useful, responsibly governed, adopted, and sustainable.  

**What you’ll bring**

* 2+ years of experience in HR, operations, or analytics.
* Degree or equivalent experience.
* Experience analyzing, improving, documenting, or managing business processes.
* Experience coordinating cross-functional projects or improvement initiatives.
* Strong problem-solving, critical-thinking, organizational, and communication skills.
* Ability to turn ambiguous needs into clear options, recommendations, and next steps.
* Ability to connect human needs, business processes, governance, and technology-enabled solutions.
* Curiosity about AI, automation, and emerging workplace technologies, paired with sound judgment about where human involvement is essential.
* Ability to build relationships and influence without direct authority.
* Comfort working across changing priorities, multiple stakeholders, and evolving requirements.
* Experience with workflow, collaboration, documentation, reporting, or information-management tools.
Experience with localization, translation, onboarding, records management, information lifecycle, learning, talent, or HR operations is preferred.  

  
  
  

**Location: This role is based remotely but if you live within a 50-mile radius of (Atlanta, Austin, Detroit, Warren, Milford or Mountain View), you are expected to report to that location three times a week, at minimum.**

jobs.description:
DeVry University strives to close our society’s opportunity gap and address emerging talent needs by preparing learners to thrive in careers shaped by continuous technological change. Through innovative programs, relevant partnerships, and exceptional care, we empower students to meaningfully improve their lives, communities, and workplaces.
  
  
Our colleague experience is an area of obsessive focus. At DeVry University, we care about you. Because, only through you can we deliver our unique Care Formula to our learners and partners.
  
  
**Opportunity:**  
The Sr. Operations Analyst, Student Finance role is a high-impact, technology-enabled position responsible for driving end-to-end operational excellence across the Student Financial lifecycle, including Financial Aid Management, Billing and Receivables, and Payment and Cash Operations.
  
  
This role operates as an embedded optimization leader within Student Finance, combining hands-on processing expertise (25%) and advanced analytics, systems optimization, and automation (75%).
  
  
The role is accountable for designing, implementing, and scaling solutions that improve efficiency, system utilization, data accuracy, and student experience serving as the operational innovation engine that helps Student Finance become innovative, scalable, and expert.
  
  
**Responsibilities:**  
**Embedded Operations & Financial Systems Expertise:**  

* Performs processing across Student Finance functions to maintain operational fluency and support priority workloads.
* Serves as a cross-functional SME across Student Financial Aid, Billing, and Payment systems.
* Executes and validates complex financial transactions, ensuring data integrity across systems.
* Supports escalations and exception handling requiring deep system knowledge.

**Systems Optimization & Automation Leadership:**  

* Leads optimization of Student Financial systems and workflows.
* Designs and implements automation solutions using Power Automate, or other automation and AI platforms, Power Query, and reporting tools.
* Partners with IT todefine system requirements and enhancements.
* Drives improvements in audit, reconciliation, and compliance processes.
* Eliminates manual work through automation and process redesign.
* Partners with operational leaders to identify opportunities for AI-driven operational improvements.

**Data, Reporting & Operational Intelligence:**  

* Analyzes data across systems to identify trends and risks.
* Develops KPI dashboards, operational scorecards, and performance monitoring frameworks that support management decision-making.
* Supports capacity planning, workload forecasting, and scalability assessments across Student Finance operations.
* Establishes data validation and monitoring frameworks.

**Process Engineering & Continuous Improvement:**  

* Maps and redesigns workflows, using visualization tools, to improve efficiency and scalability and maintains SOPs and process documentation utilizing best practices.
* Applies design thinking, systems thinking, and data-driven methodologies to identify root causes and develop sustainable solutions.
* Conducts process experiments, pilots, and proof-of-concepts to validate proposed operational improvements and emerging technologies.
* Supports project planning, requirements gathering, user acceptance testing, implementation activities, and post-launch performance measurement.
* Evaluates emerging technologies and industry best practices and recommends solutions that improve organizational effectiveness and student experience.
* Drives measurable improvements in performance metrics.

**Cross-Functional Integration & Execution:**  

* Acts as a liaison between Student Finance, IT, and Operations teams.
* Supports project execution and ensures successful implementation.
* Contributes to training and change management efforts.
* Facilitate workshops and discovery sessions to translate business needs into digital capabilities.

**Qualifications:**  

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, Information Systems, or related field.
* 4–6+ years of experience in student finance operations or process optimization.
* Experience with systems such as Banner, Salesforce, & ProSAM or other Financial Aid Management systems.
* Experience with Federal Student Aid, 3rd party billing, and VA web-based applications.
* Maintain access to federal systems, which requires no defaulted federal student loans.
* Strong technical proficiency in Excel, Power Query, Power Automate, and Power BI or equivalent technologies.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and work independently.
* Demonstrated ability to quickly learn and adapt to new technologies, systems, and tools in a fast-paced, evolving environment.

Since 1986, our passion has been improving the lives of patients and healthcare professionals through locally-owned franchise locations across the United States. fpSOLUTIONS is the learning and professional development division of Fisher Phillips LLP, an international labor and employment law firm. In addition to supporting internal initiatives, we design and deliver scalable compliance products used by organizations across industries.

Our solutions help employers reduce risk, strengthen workplace culture, and navigate complex labor and employment regulations. We operate with the agility and ownership of a product-focused team, backed by the stability and national platform of Fisher Phillips.

This is an opportunity to contribute to learning solutions that are both strategically aligned and market-facing.

**Position Summary**

We are seeking an innovative and business-focused Instructional Designer to design and deliver purposeful, engaging, and scenario-based learning solutions for compliance, data privacy, and workplace safety training. This role blends strong instructional design fundamentals with modern digital tools—including Articulate Storyline, Articulate Rise, Absorb Create, and Synthesia AI—to create impactful, scenario-based learning experiences.

The ideal candidate is both strategic and hands-on: able to identify performance and learning needs and translate business and regulatory requirements into practical, engaging learning strategies using iterative design and development practices, multimedia development, and emerging AI technologies. You will collaborate closely with subject matter experts, attorneys, and cross-functional stakeholders to build scalable, future-ready learning solutions.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design and develop engaging, accessible, and scenario-based e-learning modules for compliance, data privacy, and workplace safety training using Articulate Storyline, Articulate Rise, Absorb Create, Synthesia AI, and related authoring tools.
* Partner with attorneys and SMEs to translate compliance requirements into clear learning strategies and practical, learner-centered experiences.
* Conduct training needs analyses and recommend appropriate learning interventions based on identified performance needs.
* Develop action maps, task analyses, design strategies, content outlines, scripts, storyboards, and assessments.
* Create multimedia elements including video, AI-generated content, simulations, animations, and interactive activities when they support the learning objectives and learner experience.
* Manage stakeholder review cycles and incorporate attorney, SME, client, and internal feedback throughout development.
* Conduct functional, accessibility, and quality assurance testing to ensure learning solutions work as intended before publication.
* Publish courses in SCORM/AICC/xAPI formats and deploy content within LMS platforms.
* Ensure alignment with corporate branding, accessibility standards, and adult learning best practices.
* Evaluate training effectiveness using data and learner feedback; recommend iterative improvements.
* Maintain and update learning content to reflect business, regulatory, or process changes.
* Support ILT/VILT programs, learning pathways, and blended learning solutions.
* Create supporting visual and learning assets, including thumbnail images, certificates of completion, presentation templates, workbooks, job aids, and other resources that enhance the overall learning experience.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in related field or equivalent professional experience required.
* 4+ years of experience designing corporate learning solutions.
* Strong knowledge of instructional design approaches and practices, such as ADDIE, SAM or other iterative design models, action mapping, and task analysis.
* Experience creating design documentation including design strategies, outlines, scripts, and storyboards.
* **Hands-on experience** with Articulate Storyline and Articulate Rise **required**; additional proficiency in other eLearning authoring tools (e.g., Absorb Create, Vyond) a plus.
* Experience producing ILT, VILT, video-based, and blended learning solutions.
* Working knowledge of Adobe Creative Cloud sufficient to edit images in Photoshop, adjust graphics in Illustrator, and perform light video editing in Premiere Pro.
* Experience publishing to LMS platforms and managing SCORM/xAPI content.
* Experience working in iterative development environments and managing multiple stakeholder review cycles.
* Strong collaboration and communication skills.
* Portfolio demonstrating instructional design process and completed learning solutions.

jobs.title: Manager, Product Operations & UX
jobs.description:
Merge medical imaging solutions, offered by Merative, combine intelligent, scalable imaging workflow tools with deep and broad expertise to help healthcare organizations improve their confidence in patient outcomes and optimize care delivery.
  
  
Merge is one of the most widely deployed medical imaging platforms in the world. Radiologists and cardiologists rely on us to store, move, and read imaging studies across enterprise health systems, teleradiology reading centers, and community hospitals. We are modernizing the portfolio for the cloud and building empowered product teams that own outcomes — and this role builds the operating model and design foundation those teams run on.
  
  
The opportunity
  
  
This is an enabling-function leadership role with three connected parts. Product Operations is how product gets built and run — the product development lifecycle, program management, the operating cadence, and the tooling and data that keep everyone working from one source of truth. AI enablement is how we make that lifecycle faster and sharper — using AI to accelerate funnel development, build and pressure-test business cases, and prioritize where the org spends its capacity. UX is product design, user research, and the design system that make the reading experience consistent, usable, and clinically sound. Together they are the backbone that lets empowered teams move fast without losing quality.
  
  
You will report directly to the VP, Product, and lead across all three — serving every product team rather than owning a single product.

What you’ll own

* **Operating model and cadence.** Own how product is built and run: the product development lifecycle, the operating rhythm of planning, reviews, and metrics, and portfolio operations across teams.
* **Program management.** Own program and release management — keeping cross-team initiatives on track and dependencies, risks, and progress visible to leadership.
* **Tooling and data.** Own the product toolchain and the portfolio data and metrics, so teams and leaders share one trustworthy view of how we are doing.
* AI enablement and AI-accelerated PDLC. Own how AI is applied to the lifecycle itself — compressing the path from opportunity to validated, scoped work; standing up business cases with AI-assisted sizing and evidence; and sharpening portfolio prioritization.
* **Design and research (UX).** Lead product design, user research, and the design system — partnering with product and engineering from discovery through launch.

What you’ll do

* Standardize the product development lifecycle and operating cadence so teams discover, build, and ship consistently — with AI embedded in how the org works.
* Use AI to accelerate funnel development — shortening the path from raw opportunity to validated, scoped, ready-to-build work.
* Build the business-case discipline — AI-assisted market sizing, evidence, and ROI so investment decisions are fast, consistent, and defensible.
* Own how the portfolio gets prioritized — a transparent, evidence-backed model for ranking work and reallocating capacity as the evidence changes.
* Lead program management across the portfolio and give leadership a clear, current view of progress and risk.
* Own the product toolchain and portfolio metrics; resolve friction so teams work from one source of truth.
* Lead and grow the UX team, and evolve a design system that keeps the experience coherent across products.
* Run the early-access and customer-advisory motion that brings clinician feedback into the product early.
* Build, coach, and retain a team spanning operations and design.

What you bring

* 8+ years across product operations, program management, and/or design leadership, including running cross-functional operating models.
* Experience standardizing a product development lifecycle and operating cadence for multiple teams.
* Hands-on experience embedding AI into how product teams discover, build, and ship — and using it to speed up the funnel, business cases, and prioritization.
* Program and release management skill — you make dependencies, risk, and progress visible and keep initiatives on track.
* Design and research leadership — you have led or partnered closely with UX and owned or grown a design system.
* Fluency with product tooling and metrics, and a bias toward one source of truth.
* People leadership and clear, plain communication with product, engineering, design, and executives.

Nice to have

* Background in healthcare, medical imaging, or another regulated domain.
* Experience with AI-assisted research, synthesis, or evaluation tooling in a regulated environment.
* Familiarity with quality management systems (QMS) and regulated software development.

**Compensation**

The salary range provided in this job posting is intended to reflect the general market value for the position. The actual salary offered may vary based on factors such as the candidate’s experience, qualifications, skills, and the specific requirements of the role. This range may also be subject to change as market conditions evolve. We encourage open communication throughout the interview process to discuss compensation expectations. For base-salary + commission sales roles, the range represents On-Target Earnings.

Icon Health is a leading provider of value-based musculoskeletal (MSK) care, collaborating with payers and providers to enhance outcomes and experience for individuals. The company partners with health plans and risk-bearing providers to assume accountability for reduced total cost of care. By combining technology-enabled MSK providers with proactive care coordination and decision support services, Icon Health delivers multidisciplinary, evidence-based care.

We founded Icon Health on the conviction that every patient should be genuinely delighted with their care experience. By prioritizing patient-centered practices, ensuring clear care goals across the entire clinical team, and placing clinicians at the heart of care delivery, we aim to transform a fragmented system into one that truly serves patients. Our model uses a team-based approach to care, integrating musculoskeletal expertise and primary care to achieve better patient outcomes.

At Icon Health, we foster a culture that embraces bold thinking, rapid iteration, and practical problem-solving. We seek team members who relish challenging the status quo and thrive in vertically integrated roles—where ideas can swiftly move from concept to execution without layers of red tape. Above all, we value individuals who are eager to roll up their sleeves, tackle obstacles head-on, and create innovative solutions that improve the lives of our patients and our clinical partners.

The Strategic Operations Manager makes our care delivery and care coordination workflows better, faster, and more scalable. This is a people-focused role, but it's also an organizational one. You'll help keep our wellness programs running smoothly, make sure clients know what comes next, and work with the team to create a consistent experience from the first visit through ongoing follow-up.

**What your day may look like**

You'll spend part of your time working with clients and part of it keeping the program itself organized.

That may mean welcoming a new client and helping them understand the program, checking in with existing clients, reviewing upcoming appointments, following up with someone who has fallen off schedule, or working with the team to improve how we manage the client experience.

* Oversee day-to-day coordination of wellness and weight-management programs
* Help clients understand program steps, expectations, and available services
* Track participation, follow-ups, appointments, and client progress
* Keep communication between clients and the wellness team organized
* Support new-client onboarding and program enrollment

* Help resolve scheduling or service concerns
* Maintain accurate program and client information
* Review program activity and basic performance metrics
* Help develop ways to improve engagement and retention
* Coordinate program updates, promotions, and wellness initiatives
* Support staff with program procedures and client-service expectations

**The background we're looking for**

We're open to candidates from wellness, healthcare, fitness, weight management, nutrition programs, medical offices, client services, or other service-based businesses.

Ideally, you'll have **3+ years of experience** in program management, wellness services, healthcare operations, client services, or a related area.

Previous leadership or team-coordination experience is preferred.

A bachelor's degree in health and wellness, healthcare administration, nutrition, business, exercise science, or a related field is preferred, but relevant professional experience will also be considered.

We're looking for someone who genuinely enjoys working with people but can also keep the details organized behind the scenes.
