Headquartered in Richardson, TX, Entouch welcomes remote and hybrid candidates for this position. Learn more at www.entouchcontrols.com.

We are seeking a Deployment Project Manager to lead the installation, commissioning, and successful delivery of Entouch energy management systems across commercial facilities nationwide. This role serves as the primary point of coordination between customers, subcontractors, field teams, and internal stakeholders to ensure projects are completed safely, on time, within budget, and to Entouch quality standards.

This is a highly collaborative, field-focused role ideal for someone with strong HVAC controls knowledge, excellent communication skills, and experience managing multiple deployments simultaneously.

**What** **You’ll** **Do**

**Project Management & Execution**

* Lead end-to-end deployment activities for assigned installation projects
* Develop project schedules, execution plans, and resource coordination strategies
* Manage installation and subcontractor costs to ensure budget alignment
* Support subcontractor sourcing, bid reviews, and scope evaluations
* Track project progress, risks, and deliverables to ensure successful execution

**Customer & Stakeholder Management**

* Serve as the primary customer contact throughout project execution
* Communicate project status, timelines, and key milestones to customers and leadership
* Coordinate across internal departments including Operations, Engineering, Solutions Engineering, and Service
* Maintain accurate project documentation including schedules, RFIs, change orders, and closeout materials

**Installation & Commissioning Oversight**

* Coordinate equipment startup, commissioning, and system validation activities
* Conduct regular site visits to verify installation quality and adherence to scope
* Provide technical guidance and scope clarification to installers and subcontractors
* Identify and proactively resolve field issues to minimize schedule or cost impacts
* Ensure smooth turnover from installation to service and support teams

**Scope & Financial Management**

* Identify, document, and manage change orders and out-of-scope work
* Support contract adjustments and customer negotiations as needed
* Monitor project financial performance and support cost forecasting activities

**Continuous Improvement & Safety**

* Provide field feedback to Engineering and Product teams to improve product quality and deployment processes
* Support training initiatives for internal teams and subcontractors
* Promote and uphold all company and site safety standards

**What You'll Bring**

**Experience & Education**

* 3–5 years of project management experience in HVAC controls, building automation systems (BAS), mechanical systems, or related commercial construction environments
* Associate’s or Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Construction Management, HVAC, or a related technical discipline preferred
* PMP certification is a plus

**Technical Knowledge**

* Understanding of commercial HVAC systems, controls, and installation practices
* Familiarity with BAS/DDC controls and low-voltage electrical systems
* Ability to read construction drawings, wiring diagrams, and project specifications

**Skills & Attributes**

* Strong communication and customer relationship management skills
* Highly organized with strong attention to detail
* Ability to manage multiple projects and priorities simultaneously
* Strong problem-solving and negotiation skills
* Comfortable working independently in fast-paced field environments
* Willingness to travel approximately 10–20% domestically

**Work Environment**

This role includes occasional travel to commercial job sites across the United States, typically averaging 10–20% travel. Work may be performed in indoor and outdoor environments with occasional exposure to construction-related conditions including noise, dust, temperature fluctuations, and active mechanical or electrical systems. Flexibility for occasional after-hours support, commissioning activities, and limited travel is required.

**Why Entouch**

* Competitive compensation package
* Medical, dental, vision, life insurance, and 401(k) with company match
* Unlimited PTO plus 12 paid holidays
* Opportunity to work with innovative HVAC and IoT technologies
* High-visibility role with direct impact on customer success
* Collaborative, team-oriented culture focused on growth and quality

jobs.title: Remote Patient Enrollment Specialist – Medical Sales
jobs.description:
Overview  
Turn Patient Interest Into Meaningful Next Steps

Our growing functional medicine and naturopathic clinic is seeking an experienced phone sales professional to help prospective patients understand our services and take the next step toward care.

As a **Remote Patient Enrollment Specialist**, you will speak with inbound leads who have already expressed interest in our clinic. You’ll build rapport, understand their goals, explain services and pricing, address concerns, and guide qualified patients through enrollment.

This position combines consultative sales, patient education, and consistent follow-up. Success requires confidence discussing costs, asking for commitment, and working toward measurable sales goals.

What We Offer

* **Inbound leads:** Connect with people who have already expressed interest—no cold calling.
* **Guaranteed base pay:** $17/hour plus uncapped commission.
* **Performance-based earning potential:** Fully trained advisors typically earn $21–$30/hour in combined base pay and commission. Actual earnings vary by performance.
* **Remote work:** Work from a quiet, professional home office.
* **Paid time off and flexible scheduling.**
* **Meaningful conversations:** Help prospective patients make informed decisions about pursuing care.

What You’ll Do

* Conduct structured phone consultations with prospective patients to understand their interests, concerns, and readiness to move forward.
* Explain clinic services, the care process, pricing, and enrollment steps using clear, approved information.
* Build trust through active listening, empathy, and confident communication.
* Address questions and objections related to cost, timing, and commitment.
* Ask for the sale and guide interested, qualified patients through the next steps.
* Follow up consistently with leads who need additional information or time to decide.
* Maintain accurate CRM records, including contact activity, conversation notes, follow-up tasks, and enrollment status.
* Meet daily, weekly, and monthly goals for outreach activity, follow-up, conversion, and enrollment.
* Review performance metrics and apply feedback to improve results.
* Coordinate with the clinical team and direct questions about medical suitability, treatment recommendations, or expected outcomes to qualified providers.

What You Bring

**Required qualifications:**

* At least 1 year of phone sales, inside sales, medical sales, high-ticket sales, or similar consultative sales experience.
* A demonstrated record of meeting or exceeding sales quotas or conversion goals.
* Strong phone communication, rapport-building, and objection-handling skills.
* Confidence discussing pricing and asking for financial commitment.
* Strong organization and consistent follow-through across multiple leads.
* Comfort working in a performance-focused environment with clear KPIs.
* A quiet, professional workspace and reliable internet connection.

**Preferred qualifications:**

* Experience in healthcare, functional medicine, wellness, or patient enrollment.
* Experience selling services that require a consultative conversation.
* Familiarity with CRM systems and remote sales workflows.

**Location:** Fully Remote  
**Job Type:** Full-time; part-time considered for experienced candidates  
**Compensation:** $17/hour guaranteed base + uncapped commission  
**Typical total earnings:** $21–$30/hour for fully trained advisors, with higher earning potential based on performance

What Success Looks Like

You build trust quickly, explain information clearly, and help patients make informed decisions without pressure or promises of medical results. You take ownership of your follow-up, keep accurate records, and consistently work toward your enrollment and conversion goals.

Apply Today

If you have a proven phone sales background and enjoy combining empathy with results, we’d love to hear from you. Apply with your resume and examples of your sales performance.

Pay: $17.00 - $30.00 per hour

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* 401(k) matching
* Health insurance
* Paid time off

**What you'll do**

* Build, launch, and continuously improve digital journeys across the customer lifecycle, for all segments and regions
* Turn evolving business needs into trigger logic and communication journeys, then build and ship them yourself

* Analyze customer behavior and usage data to spot patterns that point to retention, churn risk, and expansion, then use what you find to create or refine journeys

* Strong communication skills and the ability to explain complex issues to different audiences
* The ability to turn raw usage and behavior data into clear journey logic, and to tell the story behind the data

* Preferred qualifications: Hands-on experience with Gainsight, familiarity with Salesforce and/or Pendo, and/or an MBA

**Requirements**

* Bachelor's degree
* 8+ years building and delivering large, cross-functional initiatives as an individual contributor (separate from a people-management capacity)
* 3+ years of hands-on experience with CRM platforms and GTM/sales operations data
* Demonstrated experience designing and personally implementing customer journeys or programs spanning SMB through enterprise
* Hands-on experience using data/analytics tools to analyze customer behavior data
* Experience working within a SaaS sales and renewal cycle
* **This is a remote role;** however, applicants located within 45 miles of our Westlake/Dallas, TX office should expect to work on-site Tuesday through Thursday, with remote flexibility on Mondays and Fridays. This approach enables more effective collaboration, quicker decision-making, and a stronger culture, while still providing flexibility.

**Why you'll love working here**

* We work in a blended environment that supports collaboration, flexibility, and connection across teams.
* We are mission-driven, shaping the future of tech upskillling and delivering impact that matters.
* We foster a culture of inclusion and belonging, where everyone can contribute and thrive.
* We are always learning, creating an environment where you can take on new challenges, expand your skills, and grow with purpose.

jobs.description:
SunSource and its family of companies represent 270+ locations and 4,000+ employees making up one of North America’s leading value-add industrial distribution companies. We provide customers with products and value-added solutions within Fluid Power, Fluid Process, Fluid Conveyance, Automation, General Industrial Components, and Industrial Repair. www.sun-source.com

  

The Business Development role at SunSource is key to driving profitable growth for the organization through the development and execution of SunSource’s acquisition strategy. The M&A Business Development Market Manager is a vital position within the group that works collaboratively across functions (Sales, Marketing, Legal, Human Resources, Finance, etc.) to identify and evaluate acquisition opportunities. From there, leading the charge through acquisition and into integration making this a true, full life-cycle role.

In this role, it will be vital to immerse yourself in the industrial distribution arena to evaluate acquisition opportunities within our focused technology sectors, with a particular emphasis on fluid process technologies including pumps, valves, instrumentation, flow control, process automation, measurement technologies, and related industrial process equipment. **Planning and Organizational Skills:**

* Manage the internal M&A pipeline through the identification and screening of potential acquisition candidates which may be sourced both internally and externally, while ensuring alignment with SunSource’s acquisition strategy.

### **Experience, Education and Skills**

jobs.title: Key Account Manager
jobs.description:
**Build a career powered by innovations that matter!** At Novanta, our innovations power technology products that are transforming healthcare and advanced manufacturing—improving productivity, enhancing people’s lives and redefining what’s possible. We create for our global customers engineered components and sub-systems that deliver extreme precision and performance for a range of mission-critical applications—from minimally invasive surgery to robotics to 3D metal printing.

Novanta is one global team with over 26 offices located in The Americas, Europe and Asia-Pacific. Looking for a great place to work? You have found it with a culture that embraces teamwork, collaboration and empowerment. Come explore Novanta.

  

**Summary**

  

As a Key Account Manager, you will play a pivotal role in driving strategic growth for Novanta's Precision Medicine business. This is an opportunity to partner with some of the world's leading OEMs, uncover new market opportunities, influence product roadmaps, and help bring innovative technologies to life.

  

In this highly visible role, you will serve as a trusted advisor to customers while connecting voice-of-customer insights to Novanta's commercial and product strategies. You will build executive-level relationships, identify whitespace opportunities, and translate complex customer challenges into scalable solutions that drive long-term growth.

  

**Primary Responsibilities**

* **Drive Strategic Account Growth** by expanding relationships within key OEM accounts, identifying whitespace opportunities, and developing account strategies that accelerate revenue, market share, and long-term customer value.
* **Uncover and Convert New Opportunities** through consultative customer engagement, translating workflow challenges, unmet needs, and voice-of-customer insights into qualified opportunities, project wins, and scalable production programs.
* **Influence Customer and Business Strategy** by building trusted relationships with engineering, procurement, quality, commercial, and executive stakeholders while connecting customer needs to Novanta's product and technology roadmap.
* **Lead Cross-Functional Execution** by partnering with commercial, engineering, operations, product management, and program teams to deliver customer solutions, drive account success, and support profitable growth.

  

**Required Experience, Education, Skills, Training and Competencies**

* **Strategic Commercial Leadership:** Proven success growing complex OEM or B2B accounts through consultative selling, opportunity creation, account planning, and pipeline development.
* **Customer-Centric Problem Solving:** Ability to uncover customer challenges, identify growth opportunities, and translate technical, operational, and commercial needs into actionable business solutions.
* **Executive Influence and Relationship Building:** Demonstrated ability to build credibility and influence stakeholders across all organizational levels, from engineers and procurement teams to senior executives.
* **Business Acumen and Execution Excellence:** Strong analytical, communication, and organizational skills with experience leveraging CRM tools, customer insights, and business data to drive decisions, forecast opportunities, and achieve results.

  

**Physical Requirements**

* Ability to sit for extended periods while working at a desk.
* Ability to lift, carry, and transport demonstration equipment and related materials up to 25 pounds, with or without reasonable accommodation.

Stamina for frequent travel, including long flights and car rides.  

  

**Travel Requirements**

* Expect to travel up to 50% of the time, including overnight stays.
* Ability to travel on short notice and adapt to changing schedules.
Must have a valid driver's license and reliable transportation.  

  

**Compensation and Benefits**

* The base pay for this position is $122,000 to $183,800 per year depending on the geographic market.
* This position provides an opportunity for competitive quarterly sales compensation based on an achievement to plan.
Novanta supports all aspects of your life's needs. This position provides a full range of medical, financial, and other benefits to make your quality of life better.  

  

**Why Novanta?**

At Novanta, we're united by a shared mission to deliver innovation that matters. Our technologies enable breakthroughs in healthcare, advanced manufacturing, and robotics, helping customers solve complex challenges around the world.

  

As part of Precision Medicine's Positioning Solutions business, you will connect customer insight, commercial strategy, and product innovation to help transform customer challenges into meaningful solutions, project wins, and long-term production programs.

  

If you're energized by building strategic relationships, creating growth opportunities, influencing product direction, and helping customers succeed, we'd love to hear from you.

Novanta is proud to be an equal employment opportunity and affirmative action workplace. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, military and veteran status, disability, genetics, or any other category protected by federal law or Novanta policy.

jobs.title: Instructional Designer (Contract)
jobs.description:
**ABOUT THE WORK**
------------------

Alchemy designs and builds online courses for universities and workforce education providers. You would work on a per-course basis alongside a faculty subject matter expert, taking a course from the first conversation through to a finished build the client signs off on.

Engagements are contracted per course, so you can take one course or several depending on your capacity. Most courses run eight to fourteen weeks of development.

This is a collaborative role. You will work directly with your SME on a regular cadence, and there are project and client calls from time to time. If you are looking for work that can be done entirely asynchronously with no contact with faculty or the client, this is not that role.

**WHAT YOU WILL DO**
--------------------

**Design and development**

Partner with a faculty subject matter expert to develop the course plan: learning outcomes, assessment map, and the overall shape of the course.

Write the course guide or blueprint, the document that contains everything that will be built in the LMS. This includes instructional narrative, activity and assessment design, rubrics where used, and links to resources.

Review and write learning outcomes using Bloom's Taxonomy and related frameworks, making sure they are stated in performance terms, pitched to the audience, and sequenced to match the course design.

Design formative and summative assessments, knowledge checks and learning activities that actually measure the outcomes.

Draft a media plan with the SME, specifying what each asset is for, which outcome it addresses and roughly how long it should be, then work with media producers and interactive developers to get it made.

Work to the client's templates, style guide, terminology and design standards, which differ by client and which we will give you at kickoff.

Hold the standards: accessibility (WCAG 2.1 AA), the client's style guide, and the design standards for the project. Remediating accessibility issues in your own deliverables is part of the work.

**Meetings and collaboration**

Hold regular working sessions with your subject matter expert through the design phase. Plan on a standing weekly meeting. The course gets designed in those conversations, and a designer who only emails the SME will not get what the course needs.

Attend additional project and client calls as necessary, or as your contract stipulates.

**Project administration**

Keep your own task status current in the client's project system (usually ClickUp). The project manager owns the schedule, but nobody can run a schedule off tasks that are not updated.

Run the review and approval process for your courses: submit on the dates in the plan, use the client's review request form, and route it to the named reviewers.

Review the built course in the LMS against your approved blueprint, log what needs fixing in one place, confirm the fixes landed, and sign off before it goes to the client.

Raise problems early. If a date is going to slip, an SME has gone quiet, or the scope has crept, say so while it can still be managed.

**HOW THE ENGAGEMENT WORKS**
----------------------------

Contracted per course under a work for hire agreement. Deliverables are owned by the client.

Paid a fixed fee per course at defined milestones, on acceptance of each deliverable. This is not hourly work and there is no timesheet.

A defined number of review cycles is included in the fee. The cycle count, the turnaround time we expect from you, and the revision window are stated in your contract.

Revisions requested inside that window are included. Work beyond it, or a change to the course scope after sign off, is handled as a contract amendment before it is started, not after.

Course assignments can change. Courses get added, removed, delayed or reassigned by the client. When that happens we amend the contract rather than absorbing it quietly.

You will work in our systems and the client's: Google Workspace, Slack, the project system, and the client's LMS. Some clients provide guest access with rules attached, and we will tell you what those are.

We use AI tooling in our process, including our own platform. You do not need to be an expert, but you do need to be comfortable working alongside it and following our rules about what client content can and cannot be put into external tools.

**WHAT YOU WILL BRING**
-----------------------

Experience designing courses in higher education, K-12 or workforce learning and development, with at least one full course taken from outline to delivery.

Fluency with learning management systems, Canvas and Brightspace in particular.

The ability to work with a faculty subject matter expert who is an expert in their field but not in course design, and to lead that relationship without taking it over.

Comfort in client-facing conversations, including ones where you have to say no or explain why something will not work.

Clear, structured writing and the discipline to follow a style guide and a template rather than your own preferred format.

The self-management to hit dates in a distributed team without being chased.

A degree in education, instructional design, instructional technology or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

Candor about what you have not done. We would much rather know at the application stage that you have never built an interactive or never worked in Brightspace than find out when it blocks a deliverable.

**NICE TO HAVE**
----------------

Experience with Articulate Storyline or Rise, H5P, or other interactive development tools.

Familiarity with Quality Matters or similar course design standards.

Experience picking up a partially built course from another designer and finishing it.

Experience using AI tools as part of a design workflow, with judgement about where they help and where they do not.

Experience in a specific discipline area: business, criminal justice, education, psychology, healt

We’re building a world of health around every individual — shaping a more connected, convenient and compassionate health experience. At CVS Health®, you’ll be surrounded by passionate colleagues who care deeply, innovate with purpose, hold ourselves accountable and prioritize safety and quality in everything we do. **Position Summary**

The Operations Manager is a member of the Store Management team, and as such, fulfills the company purpose of helping people on their path to better health by driving store execution and performance while building consumer loyalty to CVS/pharmacy through a focus on excellent customer service. Under the supervision of the Store Manager, the Operations Manager will maintain an engaged, productive store team through strong leadership, demonstrating initiative and leading by example.

The Operations Manager is responsible for supporting the Store Manager in the total leadership and strategic operation of a CVS/pharmacy store including:

* Overall store management, supervision, and policy implementation
* Sales and inventory management
* Employee staffing, training, and development
* Financial management
* Customer service leadership

Unlike the Store Manager in Training position, the Operations Manager position is not part of the CVS/pharmacy Retail Management Development Program. Operations Managers are not eligible for direct promotion to Store Manager. Candidates with a short-term goal of becoming a CVS Store Manager should instead apply for Store Manager in Training openings.

Essential Functions:

Lead others and work effectively with store crews

Supervise, assign and direct activities of the store’s crew

Effectively communicate information to store crew and supervisors in an open and timely manner

Support Store Manager with actions plans for operational and service improvement

2. Customer Service

Assist customers with their questions, problems and complaints

Promote CVS customer service culture (greet, offer help, and thank)

Deductive reasoning ability, advanced analytical skills and computer skills.

Experience as a retail manager or supervisor

High school diploma or equivalent required

40

Full time

$23.45 - $37.45

========================

**Job Scope:** Generally responsible for supervision and technical direction over a team of engineers and designers engaged in the total delivery of services on time, within performance budget and quality expectations. Work at this level requires extensive progressive experience in project management and involves the utilization of project controls for cost, schedule and quality of projects. This work will be performed under minimal supervision.

**Primary responsibilities will include but are not limited to:**

* Efficiently managing promotional projects minimizing the cost to Hargrove by working with the Engineering Resource Leaders to accurately estimate Professional Service man-hours to complete the project while achieving the objectives.
* Successfully managing commercial contract(s) on one or more projects of various sizes, as required. * Validating professional service and construction estimates at the beginning of a project, and then tracking changes as the project progresses.
* Participating in development of all major technical, cost, scheduling and performance decisions.
* Familiarity with project scope, specifications, deliverables required by client, and design criteria upon assignment to a project and gaining Hargrove team alignment of schedule and budget in regard to deliverables required. Work with client team to define project scope, goals and deliverables that support business goals in collaboration with stakeholders.

At PRIME, a culture of empathy, trust, and belonging are foundational. This is integral in our approach to recruiting, developing, and retaining the best people in the industry. Our growth mindset drives us to embrace challenges and discover what sparks inspiration for creative solutions. PRIME is compelled to keep evolving, and creating new opportunities for those who perform. Our comprehensive services cover the entire lifecycle of a project, capabilities include electrical construction, service and maintenance, underground, utilities services, renewable energy, and low voltage technology solutions.

Recognized as one of Silicon Valley’s Best Places to Work!

* Lead the entire project lifecycle from initiation to closure, ensuring safety, budget adherence, high-quality standards, and timely delivery.

### **What You Will Need to Be Successful**

* Bachelor’s degree in construction management or related field (architecture, engineering, etc.), and seven to ten years electrical project management experience or relevant experience and/or training; or equivalent combination of education and/or field experience.
* Strong understanding of construction cost, scheduling, estimating and engineering principles and techniques, as well as accounting practices.
* Proficiency in electrical estimating, including preparing and presenting job change orders, evaluating estimates, and contributing to new estimates.
* Proficiency with project management tools and software packages. Experience with project management tools and software packages, with a preference for familiarity with Accubid Estimating systems.

* Proficiency building critical path schedules for projects and understanding construction sequencing across all disciplines.,

* Effective identification and quantification of project impacts, along with sound negotiation skills with customers for change orders.
* Demonstrated leadership in managing people and teams.
* Excellent communication, leadership, problem solving, and analytical skills.
* Ability to rapidly adapt and respond to changing environments and priorities.
* Skill in eliciting cooperation from senior management and cross-functional departments.
* Ability to maintain a positive attitude and work environment.
* Strong computer skills and proficiency with Microsoft Office.

**Our Benefits**

* 100% coverage for Medical, Dental, and Vision, including dependents, with no premium cost to the employee
* 401k Program w/ Direct Benefit
* 100% Employer-paid Life Insurance
* Profit Sharing and Discretionary Bonus Program
* Education/ Training Reimbursement Benefit
* Paid Time off and Holiday Time Off

* *PRIME Electric does not engage with or utilize recruiting or placement agencies for any recruiting or hiring needs. PRIME hiring managers are not authorized to review or accept resume referrals from any agencies.*

This employer is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status or any other characteristics protected by federal, state, or local laws.

**Quality Assurance Manager | Building Envelope & Constructability**

Are you a construction or design professional with deep expertise in building envelopes, waterproofing, façades, and constructability?

This is an opportunity to step into a highly influential role where your technical knowledge will directly impact the quality and success of major construction projects throughout the Bay Area.

Rather than focusing solely on field inspections or traditional QA/QC documentation, this position is centered around design review, constructability, building envelope performance, risk identification, and developing better solutions before problems reach the jobsite.

You will work alongside architects, engineers, consultants, manufacturers, subcontractors, and preconstruction teams to identify potential issues early, develop solutions, and establish best practices across complex projects ranging from $5M to more than $200M.

**What You’ll Do**
------------------

As the Quality Assurance Manager, you will serve as a technical resource throughout the design and preconstruction process.

• Perform detailed constructability reviews of design documents across multiple project phases

• Focus heavily on building envelope systems, waterproofing, roofing assemblies, windows, storefronts, accessibility, and other high risk areas

• Identify design deficiencies, constructability concerns, and potential performance issues before construction begins

• Develop practical solutions and recommendations when designs fall below established standards

• Review designs for compliance with California building codes, accessibility requirements, and applicable regulations

• Lead design review meetings with architects, consultants, project teams, and other stakeholders

• Collaborate closely with Preconstruction and Estimating teams to identify risks and opportunities early

• Work directly with waterproofing consultants, manufacturers, specialty contractors, architects, and engineers

• Assist in developing RFIs and technical questions for design teams

• Research new products, materials, systems, and construction practices

• Support multiple project teams simultaneously while serving as a trusted technical resource

This is a technical leadership position, not simply a traditional QA/QC management role.

new_jobs.title: Manager, IT Service Delivery
new_jobs.description:
Olema Oncology is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company committed to transforming the standard of care and improving outcomes for patients living with breast cancer and beyond. With our transformation into a fully integrated oncology company well underway, it's an exciting time to be part of Team Olema.

Our lead product candidate, palazestrant, is a novel, orally available complete estrogen receptor antagonist (CERAN) and selective estrogen receptor degrader (SERD) currently in two pivotal Phase 3 clinical trials. We expect top-line data from OPERA-01, our ongoing Phase 3 trial of palazestrant as a monotherapy in patients with second- or third-line ER+/HER2- metastatic breast cancer (MBC), in Q1 2027 which, if positive, could lead to our first potential approval and commercial launch in 2028. OPERA-02, our Phase 3 trial of palazestrant in combination with ribociblib in patients with frontline ER+/HER2- MBC, is enrolling patients. Together with its mechanism of action, pharmacokinetic properties, and the potential to demonstrate activity in both ESR1 wild-type and mutant tumors, palazestrant could transform the metastatic breast cancer treatment paradigm and provide access to a $15 billion global market opportunity.

Our follow-on product candidate, OP-3136, is a potent KAT6 inhibitor with the potential to generate further value and meaningfully impact the metastatic breast cancer treatment landscape – particularly in combination with palazestrant. We recently presented encouraging Phase 1 monotherapy data from this program across multiple solid tumor types, are advancing patient enrollment in the ongoing combination arms in MBC, and expect to initiate a Phase 1 study of OP-3136 in combination with Bayer's darolutamide in metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer by the end of this year.

Aspiring to transform the metastatic treatment paradigm is an ambitious endeavor that requires a resolute approach to developing better therapies and passionate colleagues dedicated to helping the patients we serve feel better, longer. Team Olema possesses a deep commitment to a shared purpose, the sustained pursuit of excellence, cultivating the courage required to advance our programs, the drive to succeed, and a collective capacity for adaptability through learning, growth, and evolution. We are a small group of nimble self-starters who bring consistency in our quest for the extraordinary every single day.

If you're ready to be part of a tenacious, courageous, agile, and growing team, join us in making a profound impact, together – for our patients, for your career, and for what's beyond.

**About the Role >>> Manager IT Service Delivery**

As the Manager, IT Service Delivery reporting to the Sr. Director, IT Infrastructure and Operations you will lead end-user support services for our onsite and remote workforce, and laboratories. This full-time, fully onsite leadership role owns service desk performance, manages onsite staff and Managed Service Provider (MSP) services delivery, hardware assets depot, software licenses, laboratory support, VIP and executive coverage, and the IT onboarding experience. The successful candidate combines strong operational discipline with a service-oriented mindset, driving measurable improvements in employee experience, service quality, and reliability across a fast-paced biotechnology environment.

This role is based out of our **San Francisco, CA office (fully onsite, five days per week)** and may require **10-20% travel**.

Your work will *primarily* encompass:

**Senior Business Analyst, MMIS Finance**

**About the Role**

Lead business and functional requirements for the MMIS Financial Management module from requirements gathering through implementation and production validation. Translate Medicaid payment operations into clear requirements for business, technical, and testing teams.

**Responsibilities**

  

* Facilitate stakeholder workshops, document current-state financial processes, identify gaps, and define target-state business and system needs.
* Develop business and functional requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, process flows, decision tables, data mappings, interface requirements, and reconciliation rules.
* Analyze the end-to-end financial lifecycle, including claims payment, preliminary and final payment cycles, warrants and EFT, remittance advice, receivables, recoveries, recoupments, refunds, offsets, voids, reissues, and reconciliation.
* Trace claims and financial transactions across adjudication, payment, 835 or paper remittance, banking, general-ledger interfaces, and financial reporting.
* Collaborate with finance, program, development, architecture, and QA teams to define screens, work queues, interfaces, batch cycles, and system behavior. Maintain requirements traceability, manage backlog priorities and requirement changes, and resolve business and testing questions throughout delivery.
* Support SIT, UAT, regression testing, defect triage, root-cause analysis, and production validation, ensuring payment cycles and financial postings reconcile.
* Assess Medicaid policy, regulatory, and CMS reporting impacts and communicate financial concepts and system behavior to technical and nontechnical stakeholders.

**Requirements**

  

* Business Analyst experience with Medicaid MMIS/MES, healthcare payer systems, claims payment, or comparable financial operations.
* Knowledge of claims adjudication, provider payment, accounts payable and receivable, recoveries, adjustments, refunds, offsets, and reconciliation.
* Working knowledge of 837P, 837I, and 837D transactions and strong knowledge of the 835, including CAS, PLB, and payment balancing.
* Knowledge of Medicare crossover, coordination of benefits, and third-party liability or recovery processes that affect Medicaid payment.
* Ability to use SQL and X12 validation tools to trace claims, payments, receivables, remittances, and downstream financial data.
* Experience with requirements documentation, stakeholder facilitation, traceability, SIT, UAT, defect triage, and production validation.

* Eight or more years of business analysis or healthcare systems experience, including MMIS financial management or Medicaid payment operations.
* Experience with CMdS or another Medicaid enterprise or healthcare payer platform such as Gainwell, QNXT, HealthRules, or Facets.

new_jobs.title: Global Talent Operations Process & Enablement Analyst
new_jobs.description:
**Job Description**

The Global Talent Operations Process & Enablement Analyst improves the processes, tools, governance, and ways of working that help Global Talent operate effectively at scale.
  
You’ll identify opportunities to reduce friction, recommend practical solutions, and help implement and sustain improvements. This role combines process expertise, stakeholder partnership, thoughtful governance, and the responsible use of AI and automation to improve how work gets done. Your work will help GM deliver consistent, high-quality development experiences for employees while enabling Global Talent teams to focus on strategic priorities.
  
  
**What you’ll do**  
Improve processes and ways of working

* Analyze workflows, handoffs, and stakeholder experiences to identify root causes and opportunities for improvement.
* Lead moderate-scope improvements from discovery through implementation, iteration, and sustainment.
* Create and maintain process maps, standard work, job aids, intake paths, role definitions, and governance documentation.
* Use data and feedback to monitor adoption, measure effectiveness, resolve issues, and prioritize improvements.

Enable localization and translation

* Improve the intake, prioritization, routing, review, approval, and delivery of localized and translated learning and talent-management content.
* Coordinate content owners, subject-matter experts, vendors, tools, and stakeholders to improve quality, turnaround time, consistency, reuse, and self-service.
* Clarify trade-offs and establish practical guidance that makes global delivery more efficient and scalable.

Strengthen onboarding

* Design and maintain onboarding experiences that help direct and contract employees contribute quickly.
* Improve access to tools, information, and working connections while clarifying ownership, handoffs, and expectations.
* Use feedback and data to improve onboarding consistency, usefulness, and scalability.

Optimize information management

* Improve Records and Information Management and Information Lifecycle Management practices across Global Talent.
* Clarify information ownership, classification, retention, access, and lifecycle expectations.
* Improve findability, reduce content sprawl, and translate requirements into practical, sustainable ways of working.

Partner across Global Talent

* Support centralized Global Talent processes and services by providing guidance, triage, and routing.
* Partner with stakeholders to clarify needs, evaluate options, resolve trade-offs, and coordinate dependencies and decisions.
* Build trust through transparent communication, sound judgment, and reliable follow-through.

Use technology thoughtfully

* Identify repetitive, inconsistent, manual, or high-friction work that may benefit from process changes, AI, or automation.
* Explore and test practical solutions within privacy, security, quality, compliance, and governance expectations.
* Define appropriate human review, decision points, and escalation paths where context, empathy, judgment, or accountability matter.
Evaluate results, document learnings, and help implement solutions that deliver meaningful value.  

**What success looks like**

* Global Talent processes are clear, documented, adopted, and maintained.
* Localization and translation work is efficient, consistent, resource-conscious, and scalable.
* Direct and contract employees receive timely access to the information, tools, and connections they need to become productive.
* Information is easier to find, manage, retain, and use appropriately.
* Stakeholders experience less duplication, rework, ambiguity, and manual coordination.
* Improvements produce measurable gains in efficiency, quality, consistency, or stakeholder experience.
Technology-enabled solutions are useful, responsibly governed, adopted, and sustainable.  

**What you’ll bring**

* 2+ years of experience in HR, operations, or analytics.
* Degree or equivalent experience.
* Experience analyzing, improving, documenting, or managing business processes.
* Experience coordinating cross-functional projects or improvement initiatives.
* Strong problem-solving, critical-thinking, organizational, and communication skills.
* Ability to turn ambiguous needs into clear options, recommendations, and next steps.
* Ability to connect human needs, business processes, governance, and technology-enabled solutions.
* Curiosity about AI, automation, and emerging workplace technologies, paired with sound judgment about where human involvement is essential.
* Ability to build relationships and influence without direct authority.
* Comfort working across changing priorities, multiple stakeholders, and evolving requirements.
* Experience with workflow, collaboration, documentation, reporting, or information-management tools.
Experience with localization, translation, onboarding, records management, information lifecycle, learning, talent, or HR operations is preferred.  

  
  
  

**Location: This role is based remotely but if you live within a 50-mile radius of (Atlanta, Austin, Detroit, Warren, Milford or Mountain View), you are expected to report to that location three times a week, at minimum.**

We know infusion services, and we guide owners along the path of launch, growth, and successful business operations.

* compliance with USP Chapter and USP Chapter regulations and any applicable state Board of Pharmacy regulations related to compounding rooms, devices, supplies, and personnel. * Excellent teaching skills and ability to demonstrate and communicate critical procedures to pharmacy professionals.

new_jobs.description:
**Who We Are:**
---------------

Neurocrine Biosciences is a leading biopharmaceutical company with a simple purpose: to relieve suffering for people with great needs. We are dedicated to discovering, developing and commercializing life-changing treatments for patients with under-addressed neurological, psychiatric, endocrine and immunological disorders. The company's diverse portfolio includes FDA-approved treatments for tardive dyskinesia, chorea associated with Huntington's disease, classic congenital adrenal hyperplasia, hyperphagia in Prader-Willi syndrome, endometriosis\* and uterine fibroids\*, as well as a robust pipeline including multiple compounds in mid- to late-phase clinical development across our core therapeutic areas. For more than three decades, we have applied our unique insight into neuroscience and the interconnections between brain and body systems to treat complex conditions. We relentlessly pursue medicines to ease the burden of debilitating diseases and disorders, because you deserve brave science. For more information, visit neurocrine.com, and follow the company on LinkedIn, X, Facebook and YouTube. (*\*in collaboration with AbbVie*)

-------------------

LTC - Experience leading account teams and managing initiatives within Long-term Care or similar B2B environments. You'll design the low-touch experience for customers across every segment and region, helping them get more value, stay longer, and grow with us, without needing 1:1 coverage. This is not a people-management role. You'll shape the strategy and ship the work yourself, partnering closely with Customer Success leadership and teams across the business. **What you'll do**

* Build, launch, and continuously improve digital journeys across the customer lifecycle, for all segments and regions

new_jobs.description:
SunSource and its family of companies represent 270+ locations and 4,000+ employees making up one of North America’s leading value-add industrial distribution companies. We provide customers with products and value-added solutions within Fluid Power, Fluid Process, Fluid Conveyance, Automation, General Industrial Components, and Industrial Repair. www.sun-source.com

  

The Business Development role at SunSource is key to driving profitable growth for the organization through the development and execution of SunSource’s acquisition strategy. The M&A Business Development Market Manager is a vital position within the group that works collaboratively across functions (Sales, Marketing, Legal, Human Resources, Finance, etc.) to identify and evaluate acquisition opportunities. From there, leading the charge through acquisition and into integration making this a true, full life-cycle role.

In this role, it will be vital to immerse yourself in the industrial distribution arena to evaluate acquisition opportunities within our focused technology sectors, with a particular emphasis on fluid process technologies including pumps, valves, instrumentation, flow control, process automation, measurement technologies, and related industrial process equipment. Networking with internal and external parties will be of the utmost importance.

### **To be successful in this role you will need:**

**Business Expertise:**

* Develop a deep understanding of industrial Fluid Power, Fluid Conveyance, Automation, and Fluid Process distribution; including customers, supply chains, competitors and global market dynamics to assist in uncovering profitable growth opportunities.
* Evaluate acquisition targets operating within the Fluid Process industry and adjacent markets, assessing strategic fit, competitive positioning, supplier relationships, end-market exposure and opportunities for value creation.
* Ability to manage the entire transaction process including relationship development, deal negotiation and the coordination and management of acquisition due diligence and integration activities utilizing a cross-functional team of both internal and external functional experts. Will also lead or participate in the post-acquisition performance management process and management review sessions.
* Utilize and document “best practices” from your experience in the M&A field resulting in efficiencies, cost savings, and creative solutions around structuring options to meet strategic goals.

**Networking, Influence, and Negotiation Skills:**

* Engage with leadership throughout the transaction process assisting in the development of both the business case rationale and integration action plans. Responsible for translating business rationale and integration strategies into executive presentation materials and be capable of delivering effective presentations as well as recommendations to SunSource’s senior leadership team and its Board of Directors.
* Leads and staff appropriate cross-functional teams to complete due diligence and integration planning on tight timelines.

**Planning and Organizational Skills:**

* Support overall management of the M&A acquisition strategy including performing preliminary market research to assess the attractiveness of new business segments, product adjacencies and geographic expansion opportunities.
* Manage the internal M&A pipeline through the identification and screening of potential acquisition candidates which may be sourced both internally and externally, while ensuring alignment with SunSource’s acquisition strategy.

**Strong Financial Acumen:**

* Strong financial acumen with an ability to develop financial valuation models and perform scenario analysis accounting for business synergies, integration requirements and other due diligence findings to maximize post-transaction shareholder value.

### **Experience, Education and Skills**

* Bachelor's degree in business, marketing, or sales is preferred.
* **3 – 5 years of buy-side experience in identifying target companies and initiating buy/sell process in Mergers and Acquisitions.**
* **10+ years of experience within Industrial Distribution, with demonstrated experience in Fluid Process (pumps, valves, instrumentation, process controls, flow technologies), or related industrial technology markets.**
* Advanced proficiency with MS Office tools such as Outlook, Excel, and PowerPoint, as well as proficient internet research skills utilizing relevant tools, applications and services.
* Excellent written and verbal communications skills.
* Ability to travel minimum of 50% of the time. This role can be remote but needs to be home based within reasonable proximity to a major airport.

We create for our global customers engineered components and sub-systems that deliver extreme precision and performance for a range of mission-critical applications—from minimally invasive surgery to robotics to 3D metal printing.

Novanta is one global team with over 26 offices located in The Americas, Europe and Asia-Pacific. Looking for a great place to work? You have found it with a culture that embraces teamwork, collaboration and empowerment. Come explore Novanta.

  

**Summary**

  

As a Key Account Manager, you will play a pivotal role in driving strategic growth for Novanta's Precision Medicine business. This is an opportunity to partner with some of the world's leading OEMs, uncover new market opportunities, influence product roadmaps, and help bring innovative technologies to life.

  

In this highly visible role, you will serve as a trusted advisor to customers while connecting voice-of-customer insights to Novanta's commercial and product strategies. You will build executive-level relationships, identify whitespace opportunities, and translate complex customer challenges into scalable solutions that drive long-term growth.

  

**Primary Responsibilities**

* **Drive Strategic Account Growth** by expanding relationships within key OEM accounts, identifying whitespace opportunities, and developing account strategies that accelerate revenue, market share, and long-term customer value.
* **Uncover and Convert New Opportunities** through consultative customer engagement, translating workflow challenges, unmet needs, and voice-of-customer insights into qualified opportunities, project wins, and scalable production programs.
* **Influence Customer and Business Strategy** by building trusted relationships with engineering, procurement, quality, commercial, and executive stakeholders while connecting customer needs to Novanta's product and technology roadmap.
* **Lead Cross-Functional Execution** by partnering with commercial, engineering, operations, product management, and program teams to deliver customer solutions, drive account success, and support profitable growth.

  

**Required Experience, Education, Skills, Training and Competencies**

* **Strategic Commercial Leadership:** Proven success growing complex OEM or B2B accounts through consultative selling, opportunity creation, account planning, and pipeline development.
* **Customer-Centric Problem Solving:** Ability to uncover customer challenges, identify growth opportunities, and translate technical, operational, and commercial needs into actionable business solutions.
* **Executive Influence and Relationship Building:** Demonstrated ability to build credibility and influence stakeholders across all organizational levels, from engineers and procurement teams to senior executives.
* **Business Acumen and Execution Excellence:** Strong analytical, communication, and organizational skills with experience leveraging CRM tools, customer insights, and business data to drive decisions, forecast opportunities, and achieve results.

  

**Physical Requirements**

Stamina for frequent travel, including long flights and car rides.  

  

**Travel Requirements**

* Expect to travel up to 50% of the time, including overnight stays.
* Ability to travel on short notice and adapt to changing schedules.
Must have a valid driver's license and reliable transportation.

* The base pay for this position is $122,000 to $183,800 per year depending on the geographic market.
* This position provides an opportunity for competitive quarterly sales compensation based on an achievement to plan.
Novanta supports all aspects of your life's needs. This position provides a full range of medical, financial, and other benefits to make your quality of life better.

At Novanta, we're united by a shared mission to deliver innovation that matters. Our technologies enable breakthroughs in healthcare, advanced manufacturing, and robotics, helping customers solve complex challenges around the world.

Our purpose is advancing knowledge to improve lives.
  
We succeed by being the premier provider of strategic learning and development, scientific advisory services, and medical communications solutions for the life sciences industry.

The Senior Instructional Designer role lead s the design and writing of interactive, engaging, and creative learning solutions for life sciences industry professionals, across a number of modalities including live and virtual workshops.
